verses.text: Mu ntango, Imana yaremye amajuru n’isi.
Ico gihe isi ntiyagira imero kandi nta kintu cari kuri yo. Umwijima wari utwikiriye ikidengeri c’amazi menshi kandi Mpwemu w’Imana yatambatamba hejuru y’ayo mazi.
Imana iravuga iti: “Nihabeho umuco,” maze umuco ubaho.
Imana ibona ko umuco ari mwiza, hanyuma iwutandukanya n’umwijima.
Imana yita umuco “umurango”, umwijima na wo iwita “ijoro”. Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa mbere.
Imana iravuga iti: “Nihabeho ikirere hagati y’amazi n’ayandi, kugira ngo gitandukanye amazi yo hejuru n’ayo kw’isi.”
Nuko Imana ishiraho ikirere co gutandukanya amazi yo kw’isi n’ayo hejuru.
Imana yita ico kirere “ijuru”. Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa kabiri.
Imana iravuga iti: “Amazi yo musi y’ijuru niyegeranire mu kibanza kimwe, hanyuma haboneke ahantu humutse.” Nuko bigenda uko nyene.
Imana yita ahantu humutse “isi”, amazi yegeraniye hamwe na yo iyita “ikiyaga”. Imana ibona ko vyose ari vyiza.
Imana iravuga iti: “Isi nimereko ivyatsi n’ibiterwa vy’ubwoko bwose: ibiterwa bifise imbuto n’ibiti vyama ivyamwa bifise imbuto muri vyo, nk’uko amoko yavyo angana.” Nuko bigenda uko nyene.
Isi izana ibimera: ibiterwa bifise imbuto nk’uko amoko yavyo ari hamwe n’ibiti vyama ivyamwa bifise imbuto muri vyo nk’uko amoko yavyo ari. Imana ibona ko ari vyiza.
Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa gatatu.
Imana iravuga iti: “Nihabeho ivyaka kw’ijuru kugira ngo bitandukanye umurango n’ijoro; maze bibe ibimenyetso bitandukanya ibihe, imisi n’imyaka.
Ivyo vyaka biri kw’ijuru nivyakire isi.” Nuko bigenda uko.
Imana irema ivyaka bibiri binini: icaka cane co kuganza umurango n’icaka bukebuke co kuganza ijoro. Yongera irema n’inyenyeri.
Nuko Imana ibishira kw’ijuru kugira ngo biboneshereze isi,
biganze umurango n’ijoro, vyongere bitandukanye umuco n’umwijima. Kandi Imana ibona ko ari vyiza.
Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa kane.
Imana iravuga iti: “Ibifise ubuzima nivyuzure mu mazi, inyoni na zo niziguruke hejuru y’isi mu kirere.”
Nuko Imana irema ibifise ubuzima binini vyo mu kiyaga n’ikintu cose gihema kandi kiba mu mazi nk’uko amoko yavyo ari, hamwe n’inyoni zose nk’uko amoko yazo ari. Kandi Imana ibona ko ari vyiza.
Nuko Imana irabihezagira, ivuga iti: “Nimurondoke, mugwire mwuzure amazi yo mu biyaga; inyoni na zo nizigwire zuzure isi.”
Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa gatanu.
Imana iravuga iti: “Isi niyuzure ibifise ubuzima nk’uko amoko yavyo ari: ibikoko vy’ibitungwa, ibikoko vyikwega hasi n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba.” Nuko biba uko nyene.
Imana irema ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, ibikoko vy’ibitungwa n’ibikoko vyikwega hasi, vyose nk’uko amoko yavyo ari. Kandi Imana ibona ko ari vyiza.

Nuko Imana iravuga iti: “Tureme abantu mw’ishusho yacu, base natwe, baheze baganze amafi yo mu mazi, inyoni zo mu kirere, ibikoko vyose vy’ibitungano, ivyo mw’ishamba hamwe n’ibikoko bigenda vyikwega hasi vyose.”
Nuko Imana irema abantu mw’ishusho yayo. Mw’ishusho yayo ni ho yabaremye; ibarema ari umugabo n’umugore.
Nuko Imana irabahezagira, ivuga iti: “Nimurondoke mugwire; mwuzure isi kandi muyiganze. Muganze amafi yo mu biyaga, inyoni zo mu kirere hamwe n’ibindi biremwa vyose bigendagenda kw’isi.”
Maze Imana iravuga iti: “Ndabahaye ibiterwa vyose bifise imbuto hamwe n’ibiti vyama ivyamwa bifise imbuto muri vyo biri kw’isi yose. Bizobabera ivyokurya.
Ibikoko vyose vyo kw’isi n’inyoni zose zo mu kirere, ibikoko vyose bigenda vyikwega hasi; ni ukuvuga ibifise ubuzima vyose; ndabihaye ivyatsi ngo bibibere ivyokurya.” Nuko bigenda uko nyene.
Maze Imana yihweza ivyo yaremye vyose, ibona ko ari vyiza cane. Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa gatandatu.
Uko ni ko iremwa ry’isi n’ijuru n’ibintu vyose biri muri vyo ryarangiye.
Ku musi ugira indwi, Imana yari yamaze kurangiza igikorwa cayo co kurema. Nuko kuri uwo musi iraruhuka ibikorwa vyayo vyose.
Imana ihezagira umusi ugira indwi iraweza, kuko kuri uwo musi yaruhutse igikorwa cayo c’irema.
Iyi ni yo nkuru y’iremwa ry’isi n’ijuru. Uhoraho Imana ni we yaremye isi n’ijuru.
Nta bimera ku misozi vyari bwamere kw’isi kandi nta biti vyari bwakure, kuko Uhoraho Imana atari bwarungike imvura kw’isi, kandi nta muntu yari ahari wo kuyirima.
Ariko imigezi yiburuka iva mu kuzimu ikavomera isi.
Nuko Uhoraho Imana arema umuntu mu mukungugu wo hasi, ahumekera impwemu y’ubuzima mu mazuru yiwe, maze wa muntu aca aba uwufise ubuzima.
Nuko Uhoraho Imana ategura itongo muri Edeni, ku ruhande rwo mu buseruko; aba ari ho ashira wa muntu yarema.

Uhoraho Imana ameza ibiti vy’ubwoko bwose muri iryo tongo, ibiti bibereye ijisho kandi vyama ivyamwa biryoshe. Hagati muri iryo tongo ahashira igiti c’ubugingo n’igiti co kumenyekanisha iciza n’ikibi.
Uruzi rwavomera iryo tongo rwatemba ruva muri Edeni, rukigaburamwo inzuzi zine.
Uruzi rwa mbere rwitwa Pishoni, urwo rwatemba mu karere kose ka Havila, ahari inzahabu.
Inzahabu zo muri ako karere ni nziza cane. Hari kandi n’ibimota neza bidasanzwe, n’ayandi mabuye y’agaciro bita onigisi.
Uruzi rwa kabiri rwitwa Gihoni rwatembera mu karere ka Kushi.
Uruzi wa gatatu rwitwa Tigiri. Urwo na rwo rwatemba rwerekeye mu buseruko bwa Ashuri. Uruzi rwa kane rwitwa Efurate.
Uhoraho Imana ashira wa muntu mw’itongo rya Edeni kugira ngo aririme yongere arizigame.
Ariko Uhoraho Imana agabisha wa muntu ati: “Urashobora kurya ku vyamwa vy’igiti cose kiri muri iri tongo.
Ariko ntiwemerewe kurya ku giti kimenyekanisha iciza n’ikibi, kuko umusi wakiriyeko uzopfa nta kabuza.”
Uhoraho Imana aravuga ati: “Si vyiza ko umuntu yibana wenyene. Ngira ndamuronderere umufasha bakwiranye.”

Nuko Uhoraho Imana arema mw’ivu ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba n’inyoni zose zo mu kirere, vyose abicisha imbere ya wa muntu kugira ngo avyite amazina, kandi uko yita ikiri n’ubuzima cose, ryaca riba izina ryaco.
Yise amazina ibikoko vyose vy’ibitungwa, inyoni zose zo mu kirere n’ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba. Ariko uwo muntu ntiyashoboye kuronkamwo umufasha bakwiranye.
Nuko Uhoraho Imana asinziriza wa muntu ubutikoma. Agisinziriye, amukuramwo urubavu rumwe, maze muri ico kibanza ruvuyemwo ahuzuza inyama.
Maze Uhoraho Imana abumba umugore muri urwo rubavu, araheza amuzanira wa mugabo.
Wa mugabo aca aravuga ati: “Iri ni igufa ryo mu magufa yanje, ni agace k’umubiri wanje! Azokwitwa ‘umugore’ kuko yakuwe mu mugabo.”
Ni co gituma umugabo azosiga se na nyina akabana n’umugore wiwe ubutakivana, maze bakaba umubiri umwe.
Uwo mugabo n’uwo mugore bari gusa, ariko nta soni vyabatera.

Mu bikoko vyo mw’ishamba Uhoraho Imana yari yararemye, inzoka ni yo yarusha ibindi ubugunge. Umusi umwe ibaza wa mugore iti: “Ni ivy’ukuri ko Imana yababwiye iti: ‘Ntimukarye ku vyamwa vyo ku giti na kimwe co mw’itongo’?”
Wa mugore yishura ya nzoka iti: “Turashobora kurya ku vyamwa vyo ku biti vyo mw’itongo,
ariko Imana yavuze iti: ‘Ntimukarye ku vyamwa vy’igiti kiri hagati mw’itongo, ndetse ntimukagikoreko; kuko nimwabikora, muzopfa.’ ”
Ya nzoka ibwira wa mugore iti: “Ni ukuri ntimuzopfa.
Imana irazi ko umusi mwariye ku vyamwa vyaco amaso yanyu azokwuguruka, mukamera nk’Imana ku bijanye no kumenya iciza n’ikibi.”
Nuko wa mugore abona ko ivyamwa vya ca giti ari vyiza, ko bibereye kuribwa kandi ko bituma umuntu agira ubwenge. Aca afata bimwe mu vyamwa vyaco arabirya, yongera ahako n’umugabo wiwe, na we ararya.
Ubwo nyene amaso yabo bompi aruguruka, batahura ko bari gusa, baca batangura guterateranya amababi y’ibiti vy’imisukoni kugira ngo baronke ivyo bipfuka.
Ku mugoroba akayaga kariko karahuhuta, wa mugabo n’umugore wiwe bumva Uhoraho Imana agendagenda mw’itongo, baca barinyegeza mu biti kugira ngo ntababone.
Uhoraho Imana ahamagara wa mugabo, aramubaza ati: “Uri hehe?”
Na we arishura ati: “Numvise uriko uragendagenda mw’itongo ngira ubwoba nca ndinyegeza kuko ndi gusa.”
Uhoraho Imana aramubaza ati: “Ni nde yakubwiye ko uri gusa? Woba wariye ku vyamwa vya ca giti kandi narabikubujije?”
Wa mugabo arishura ati: “Ni wa mugore wampa yampaye kuri ivyo vyamwa nca ndarya.”
Uhoraho Imana abaza wa mugore ati: “Ni kuki wakoze ivyo?” Wa mugore arishura ati: “Inzoka ni yo yampenze, ni co gituma nanje nariye kuri ico camwa.”

Nuko Uhoraho Imana abwira ya nzoka ati: “Ko wubahutse gukora ivyo, uravumwe kurusha ibikoko vyose vy’ibitungwa n’ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba. Uzohora ugenda ukwega inda hasi kandi uzorya umukungugu ubuzima bwawe bwose.
Nzoshira urwanko hagati yawe n’uwu umugore no hagati y’uruvyaro rwawe n’uruvyaro rwiwe; azokumena umutwe, nawe uzomukomora ku gitsintsiri.”
Abwira wa mugore na we ati: “Nzogwiza ububabare bwawe mu gihe cawe co kuvyara; uzovyara abana ubanje kubabara. Uzohora wipfuza umugabo wawe, na we azokuganza.”

Abwira Adamu na we ati: “Ko wumviye umugore wawe, ukarya ku vyamwa vya ca giti kandi nari narakwihanikirije nti: ‘Ntiwemerewe kurya ku vyamwa vyaco,’ Isi iravumwe kubera wewe; uzoronka ivyo urya ubanje kuyirima ukaruha ubuzima bwawe bwose.
Izokumerera amahwa n’ibitovu, kandi uzorya ibimeze kuri yo.
Kubira icuya mu ruhanga ni kwo kuzotuma uronka ivyokurya kugeza usubiye mw’ivu, kuko ari ryo wavuyemwo. Kuko uri umukungugu, kandi uzosubira mu mukungugu.”
Nuko Adamu yita umugore wiwe Eva, kuko ni we yari agiye kuba nyina w’abafise ubuzima bose.
Maze Uhoraho Imana akorera Adamu na Eva impuzu mu nsato z’ibikoko arabambika.
Uhoraho Imana aravuga ati: “Umuntu amaze kumera nkatwe mu bijanye no kumenya iciza n’ikibi. Hamwe yokwamura ivyamwa vyo ku giti c’ubugingo akabirya, yoca abaho ibihe bidashira.”
Nuko Uhoraho Imana aca yirukana wa muntu muri rya tongo rya Edeni amurungika kurima isi yaremwemwo.
Amaze kwirukana wa muntu, aca ashira mu buseruko bw’itongo rya Edeni abakerubi hamwe n’inkota yaka umuriro iguma igenda igaruka kugira ngo irinde inzira ija ku giti c’ubugingo.
Nuko Adamu aryamana na Eva umugore wiwe, na we asama inda, avyara umwana bamwita Kayini. Aravuga ati: “Navyaye umuntu ndabifashijwemwo n’ Uhoraho !”
Mu nyuma avyara uwundi mwana w’umuhungu, bamwita Abeli. Bamaze gukura, Abeli aba umwungere w’intama, Kayini na we aba umurimyi.
Igihe kimwe, Kayini azana bimwe mu vyimburwa vyiwe abitanga nk’ishikanwa imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Abeli na we azana intama zavutse ubwa mbere, arazibaga, atanga inyama zazo zinuze nk’ishikanwa. Nuko Uhoraho ashima ishikanwa rya Abeli,
ariko ntiyashima Kayini n’ishikanwa ryiwe. Maze ivyo bituma Kayini ashavura cane, ariraburanirwa.
Uhoraho abaza Kayini ati: “Ni kuki ushavuye utyo? Ni kuki wiraburaniwe?
Niwakora ibitunganye, uzoshimwa. Ariko niwakora ibidatunganye, icaha kibunze ku muryango kandi gishaka kukuganza, ariko ukwiye kukinesha.”
Umusi umwe Kayini abwira murumunawe Abeli ati: “Ingo tujane mu mirima.” Bashitseyo, Kayini ahindukirira murumunawe Abeli, aramwica.
Hanyuma Uhoraho abaza Kayini ati: “Murumunawe Abeli ari hehe?” Na we arishura ati: “Sindabizi. None ni jewe njejwe kuragira murumunanje?”
Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Ivyo wakoze ni ibiki? Amaraso ya murumunawe ariko arasemerera ampamagara avugira mw’ivu!
Ubu rero uravumwe kandi urirukanywe kuri iyi si yasamye ikamira amaraso ya murumunawe.
Niwarima, nta co uzokwimbura. Uzoba inyererezi igendagenda kw’isi.”
Kayini yishura Uhoraho ati: “Igihano ndonse kiraremereye kandi kirandengeye.
Unyirukanye muri kino gihugu kandi unyirukanye imbere yawe. Ungize inyererezi itagira aho iba kw’isi kandi umuntu wese azombona ashobora kunyica.”
Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Oya, si ko bizogenda. Umuntu azokwica Kayini azobihanirwa incuro indwi.” Nuko Uhoraho ashira kuri Kayini ikimenyetso co kugabisha kugira ngo uwuzomubona ntazomwice.
Nuko Kayini ava imbere y’ Uhoraho , aja kuba mu gihugu c’i Nodi, mu buseruko bwa Edeni.
Maze Kayini aryamana n’umugore wiwe, na we asama inda avyara umwana bamwita Enoki. Kayini yubaka igisagara, acita Enoki, acitiriye umuhungu wiwe.
Enoki avyara umwana amwita Iradi; Iradi na we avyara Mehuyayeli; Mehuyayeli na we avyara Metushayeli; Metushayeli na we avyara Lameki.
Lameki arongora abagore babiri, umwe yitwa Ada uwundi Zila.
Ada avyara Jabali, maze Jabali aba sekuruza w’ababa mu mahema kandi b’aborozi.
Murumunawe yitwa Jubali. Uwo na we yabaye sekuruza w’abavuza inanga n’imyironge.
Zila na we avyara umwana amwita Tubali-Kayini. Na we yabaye umuhinga mu gucura ibikoresho mu mwakaka no mu vyuma. Tubali-Kayini yari afise mushikiwe yitwa Nama.
Umusi umwe Lameki abwira abagore biwe ati: “Ada na Zila, nimunyumvirize, bapfasoni banje, nimwumve amajambo yanje. Narishe umuntu kuko yankomerekeje, nica n’umusore kuko yankubise.
Nimba uwishe Kayini abihanirwa incuro indwi, uwishe Lameki we azobihanirwa incuro mirongo indwi n’indwi.”
Adamu yongera kuryamana n’umugore wiwe, na we avyara umuhungu amwita Seti, kuko yavuga ati: “Imana impaye uwundi mwana mu kibanza ca Abeli, uwo Kayini yishe.”
Seti na we avyara umuhungu, amwita Enoshi. Muri ico gihe abantu ni ho batangura kwambaza izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Uru ni rwo rukurikirane rw’abakomoka kuri Adamu. Igihe Imana yarema abantu, yabaremye mw’ishusho yayo.
Yabaremye ari umugabo n’umugore kandi irabahezagira, maze ibita “abantu” igihe baremwa.
Adamu amaze imyaka ijana na mirongo itatu, yavyaye umuhungu yasa na we cane, ishusho yiwe bwite; maze amwita Seti.
Seti amaze kuvuka, Adamu yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana umunani ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Adamu yamaze imyaka amajana icenda na mirongo itatu, hanyuma arapfa.
Seti amaze imyaka ijana n’itanu yavyaye Enoshi.
Amaze kuvyara Enoshi, Seti yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana umunani n’indwi, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Seti yamaze imyaka amajana icenda na cumi n’ibiri, hanyuma arapfa.
Enoshi amaze imyaka mirongo icenda, yavyaye Kenani.
Kenani amaze kuvuka, Enoshi yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana umunani na cumi n’itanu ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Enoshi yabayeho imyaka amajana icenda n’itanu, hanyuma arapfa.
Kenani amaze imyaka mirongo indwi, yavyaye Mahalaleli.
Mahalaleli amaze kuvuka, Kenani yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana umunani na mirongo ine, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Kenani yamaze imyaka amajana icenda na cumi, hanyuma arapfa.
Mahalaleli amaze imyaka mirongo itandatu n’itanu, yavyaye Yaredi.
Yaredi amaze kuvuka, Mahalaleli yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana umunani na mirongo itatu, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Mahalaleli yamaze imyaka amajana umunani na mirongo icenda n’itanu, hanyuma arapfa.
Yaredi amaze imyaka ijana na mirongo itandatu n’ibiri, yavyaye Enoki.
Enoki amaze kuvuka, Yaredi yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana umunani, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Yaredi yamaze imyaka amajana icenda na mirongo itandatu n’ibiri, hanyuma arapfa.
Enoki amaze imyaka mirongo itandatu n’itanu, yavyaye Metusela.
Metusela amaze kuvuka, Enoki yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana atatu, agendana n’Imana, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Enoki yamaze imyaka amajana atatu na mirongo itandatu n’itanu,
agendana n’Imana. Hanyuma umusi umwe arazimangana abantu baramubura, kuko Imana yamujanye.
Metusela amaze imyaka ijana na mirongo umunani n’indwi, yavyaye Lameki.
Lameki amaze kuvuka, Metusela yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana indwi na mirongo umunani n’ibiri, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Metusela yamaze imyaka amajana icenda na mirongo itandatu n’icenda, hanyuma arapfa.
Lameki amaze imyaka ijana na mirongo umunani n’ibiri, yavyaye umwana w’umuhungu.
Nuko uwo muhungu amwita Nowa, avuga ati: “Uzotuzanira ihumure mu bikorwa vy’umuruho tugira mu kurima iyi si Uhoraho yavumye.”
Nowa amaze kuvuka, Lameki yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana atanu na mirongo icenda n’itanu ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Lameki yamaze imyaka amajana indwi na mirongo indwi n’indwi, hanyuma arapfa.
Nowa amaze imyaka amajana atanu, yavyaye abahungu batatu, ari bo Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti.
Abantu bamaze kugwira kw’isi bakavyara abakobwa,
abana b’Imana babonye ko abo bakobwa b’abantu ari beza, maze barongora abo bihitiyemwo.
Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Mpwemu wanje ntazokwama yihanganira abantu, kuko ari imibiri ipfa gusa. Kuva ubu ntibazorenza imyaka ijana na mirongo ibiri.”
Muri iyo misi, no mu misi yakurikiye, kw’isi haba ibigatanya vy’Abanefilimu. Aho ni igihe abana b’Imana begera abakobwa b’abantu bakavyarana na bo. Abo ni bo bahizi ba kera, abantu ba rurangiranwa.
Maze Uhoraho abona ingene ibibi abantu bakora vyabaye vyinshi kw’isi, n’ingene ivyo bakora n’ivyo biyumvira imisi yose ari ibibi gusa.
Ivyo bituma Uhoraho yicuza igituma yararemye abantu akabashira kw’isi, umutima wiwe wuzura umubabaro.

Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Ngiye kurandura aba bantu bose naremye ndabakure kw’isi. Nzobarandurana n’ibikoko bininibinini na bitobito, ivyikwega hasi n’inyoni zo mu kirere, kuko ndicujije icatumye ndabirema.”
Ariko Nowa we Uhoraho amugirira ubuntu.
Iyi ni yo nkuru ya Nowa n’umuryango wiwe. Nowa yari umugororotsi, ni we muntu wenyene yaba kw’isi muri ico gihe atagira umugayo kandi yagendana n’Imana.
Nowa yari afise abahungu batatu: Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti.
Muri ico gihe, isi yari yarononekaye mu maso y’Imana, yuzuyemwo ubugizi bwa nabi.
Nuko Imana yihweza ingene isi yononekaye, kuko abantu bose bo kw’isi bakora ibibi,
maze ibwira Nowa iti: “Nafashe ingingo yo kurandura abantu bose, kuko isi yuzuye ibibi ku bwabo. Ngiye kubarandurana n’isi!
Wewe niwibazire ubwato mu giti citwa goferi. Uze ubushiremwo ivyumba hanyuma ubuhomeshe ikaburimbi imbere n’inyuma.

Uku ni ko uzobukora: uburebure buze bube ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana atatu, ubwaguke ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu, uburebure bw’igihagararo na bwo ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itatu.

Uze usakare ubwo bwato, ariko usigaze umwanya wuguruye ungana n’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe musi y’igisakazo. Uze kandi ushire umuryango mu mbavu, hanyuma wubake ibisenge bitatu, ico hasi, ico hagati n’ico hejuru.
Ngiye guteza umwuzure kw’isi uzorandura ikintu cose kizima musi y’ijuru. Ikintu cose kiri kw’isi kizopfa.
Ariko nzogirana isezerano nawe. Uze winjire mu bwato, wewe n’umugore wawe, n’abahungu bawe n’abagore babo.
Uze winjirane mu bwato bibiribibiri mu bifise ubuzima vyose, ikigabo n’ikigore mu bwoko bwose bw’ibikoko, kugira ngo bikirane nawe.
Inyoni zibirizibiri mu bwoko bwose bw’inyoni, ibikoko bibiribibiri vyo mu bwoko bwose bw’ibikoko bininibinini, n’ivyikwega hasi; vyose bizoza aho uri kugira ngo bikirane nawe.
Kandi uze wibuke kujana ivyokurya bikwiye umuryango wawe n’ibikoko vyose.”
Nuko Nowa akora vyose nk’uko Imana yabimutegetse.
Uhoraho abwira Nowa ati: “Injira mu bwato, wewe n’umuryango wawe wose, kuko nasanze ari wewe wenyene ugororotse mu bantu b’iki gihe.
Injirana ibikoko indwi vyo mu bwoko bwose bidahumanye, ikigabo n’ikigore; na bibiribibiri mu bikoko bihumanye, ikigabo n’ikigore,
wongere winjirane inyoni indwi zo mu bwoko bwose, ingabo n’ingore. Uko ni ko ubwoko bwavyo buzobandanya bubaho kw’isi inyuma y’umwuzure.
Mu misi indwi ngiye kurungika imvura kw’isi imare imisi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ine igwa, kugeza ndanduye ikintu cose kizima naremye.”
Nuko Nowa akora ivyo Uhoraho yamutegetse vyose.
Nowa yari amaze imyaka amajana atandatu igihe umwuzure warengera isi.
Nuko Nowa, abahungu biwe, umugore wiwe n’abakazana biwe binjira mu bwato kugira ngo bahunge umwuzure.
Ubwoko bwose bw’ibikoko bidahumanye n’ibihumanye, n’ubw’inyoni hamwe n’ubw’ibikoko bitobito vyikwega hasi
vyinjirana na Nowa mu bwato ari bibiribibiri, ikigabo n’ikigore, nk’uko Imana yari yabitegetse Nowa.
Imisi indwi iheze ni ho umwuzure waza kw’isi.
Nowa amaze imyaka amajana atandatu, ku musi ugira indwi w’ukwezi kwa kabiri, amazi yose y’i kuzimu arazikuruka, n’ingomero zo mw’ijuru ziragomoroka.
Nuko imvura igwa kw’isi imisi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ine.
Uwo musi nyene ni ho Nowa yinjirana mu bwato n’umugore wiwe, n’abahungu biwe: Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti hamwe n’abagore babo.
Bari kumwe n’ibikoko vy’ubwoko bwose: ibitungano n’ibinyeshamba, ivyikwega hasi, hamwe n’ubwoko bwose bw’inyoni n’ibiguruka.
Bibiribibiri mu vyaremwe vyose bifise ubuzima vyaje aho Nowa ari vyinjira mu bwato.
Ivyinjiye vyari ikigore n’ikigabo vyo mu bwoko bwose, nk’uko Imana yari yabitegetse Nowa. Hanyuma Uhoraho aca avyugaranira mu bwato na Nowa.
Nuko umwuzure ubandanya kwongerekana kumara imisi mirongo ine; amazi aba menshi, maze bwa bwato buca butangura kureremba hejuru y’isi.
Amazi amaze kuduga akagwira rwose kw’isi, ubwato buca bureremba hejuru yayo.
Nuko amazi aragwira cane kw’isi arengera n’imisozi miremire yo musi y’ijuru,
araduga arengera amasonga y’imisozi iruta iyindi gushika nko ku ngero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi na zitanu.
Ibifise ubuzima vyose biri kw’isi birapfa: inyoni, ibikoko vy’ibitungwa, ibenyeshamba n’ibindi bikoko bitobito vyikwega hasi, n’abantu bose.
Ikintu cose kizima caba kw’isi kirapfa.
Uko ni ko Imana yaranduye ikintu cose gifise ubuzima: abantu, ibikoko, ivyikwega hasi hamwe n’inyoni zo mu kirere; vyose vyararanduwe. Nowa n’abari kumwe na we mu bwato ni bo bonyene barokotse.
Kandi umwuzure wamaze imisi mirongo itanu urengeye isi.
Maze Imana yibuka Nowa n’ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba hamwe n’ibitungano vyari kumwe na we mu bwato, nuko irungika umuyaga kw’isi, maze amazi atangura kugabanuka.
Amazi y’i kuzimu ntiyasubira kuzikuruka, kandi na ya mvura y’isegenya irahita.
Nuko amazi y’umwuzure abandanya agabanuka kw’isi. Inyuma y’imisi ijana na mirongo itanu yari yagabanutse cane.
Ku musi ugira indwi w’ukwezi kw’indwi, bwa bwato buhagarara kuri umwe mu misozi ya Ararati.
Nuko amazi abandanya agabanuka gushika mu kwezi kw’icumi. Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’icumi ni ho amasonga y’imisozi yatangura kuboneka.
Inyuma y’imisi mirongo ine, Nowa yugurura idirisha yari yarasigaje ku bwato,
arekura igikona, na co kiraguruka kigenda kigaruka, kugeza igihe amazi yakamye kw’isi.
Hanyuma Nowa arekura inuma kugira ngo arabe ko amazi yagabanutse kw’isi.
Ariko iyo numa ibura aho igwa, kuko amazi yari akirengeye isi. Nuko igaruka ku bwato, maze Nowa agorora ukuboko yinjiza ya numa mu bwato.
Haheze iyindi misi indwi, Nowa yongera kurekura ya numa kandi.
Ya numa igarutse ku mugoroba, izana ibabi rishasha ry’igiti ca Elayo mu kanwa kayo. Maze Nowa atahura ko amazi yagabanutse kw’isi.
Yongera arindira iyindi misi indwi, maze arekura ya numa kandi; ariko uwo musi ntiyagaruka.

Ico gihe Nowa yari amaze imyaka amajana atandatu n’umwe. Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere kw’uwo mwaka, amazi yari yamaze gukama. Nuko Nowa akurako icari gipfutse ubwato, maze abona ko isi iriko irumuka.
Ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri n’indwi w’ukwezi kwa kabiri isi yari imaze kwumuka rwose.
Imana ibwira Nowa iti:
“Va mu bwato, wewe n’umugore wawe, n’abahungu bawe hamwe n’abagore babo.
Rekura ibifise ubuzima vyose muri kumwe, inyoni, ibikoko n’ivyikwega hasi, kugira ngo birondoke kandi bigwire kw’isi.”
Nuko Nowa, umugore wiwe, abahungu biwe n’abagore babo bava mu bwato.
Ibikoko vyose, ivyikwega hasi n’inyoni zose n’ibigendagenda kw’isi vyose birasohoka biva mu bwato, nk’uko amoko yavyo ari.
Maze Nowa yubakira Uhoraho igicaniro, afata bimwe mu bikoko n’inyoni bidahumanye, abitangako ikimazi kuri ico gicaniro.

Uhoraho anezerezwa n’ubumote bw’ico kimazi, araheza yivugana mu mutima ati: “Sinzosubira kuvuma isi ndayiziza abantu, naho ivyiyumviro vyo mu mitima yabo ari bibi kuva mu buto bwabo. Kandi sinzosubira kurandura ibifise ubuzima vyose nk’uko mpejeje kubikora.
Isi ikiriho, igihe co kubiba n’ico kwimbura, igihe c’imbeho n’ic’ubushuhe, igihe c’ici n’ic’agatasi, hamwe n’igihe c’ijoro n’ic’umurango, bizokwamaho.”
Nuko Imana ihezagira Nowa n’abahungu biwe irababwira iti: “Nimurondoke mugwire mwuzure isi.
Ibikoko vyose vyo kw’isi, inyoni zose zo mu kirere, ibikoko bitobito vyikwega hasi, n’amafi yose yo mu biyaga bizobatinya bicike ivutu imbere yanyu. Vyose ndabishize musi y’ububasha bwanyu.
Ibintu vyose bigendagenda bibaho ndabibahaye kugira ngo bibabere ivyokurya, nk’uko nabahaye ibiterwa.
Ariko ntimuze mwigere murya inyama zikirimwo ubuzima, ari yo maraso.
Kandi uwuzosesa amaraso y’uwundi muntu nzobimuhanira; n’igikoko na co kizokwica umuntu gitegerezwa gupfa. Umuntu wese azokwica uwundi ategerezwa gupfa na we.
Uwuzosesa amaraso y’umuntu, amaraso yiwe na we azoseswa n’uwundi muntu; kuko mw’ishusho y’Imana, ni ho umuntu yaremwe.
Mwebwe nimurondoke mugwire, mwuzure isi.”
Imana yongera ibwira Nowa n’abahungu biwe iti:
“Ngira ngirane isezerano namwe hamwe n’uruvyaro rwanyu,
n’ivyaremwe vyose vyavanye namwe mu bwato: inyoni, ibikoko vy’ibitungwa, n’ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba; muri make, ikintu cose kizima kiri kw’isi.
Nshizeho iri sezerano hagati yanje namwe, ko amazi y’umwuzure atazosubira kurandura ibifise ubuzima; ntihazosubira kubaho umwuzure ngo urandure isi.”
Imana yongerako iti: “Iki ni co kimenyetso c’isezerano ngiranye namwe n’ikintu cose kizima kiri kumwe namwe, kandi rikaba ari n’isezerano ry’abazovuka hanyuma:
Nshizeho umunywamazi mu bicu; ni wo uzoba ikimenyetso c’isezerano ngiranye namwe n’isi yose.
Ninarungika ibicu hejuru y’isi, maze umunywamazi ukaboneka,
nzoca nibuka isezerano nagiranye namwe n’ivyaremwe vyose. Amazi y’umwuzure ntazosubira kurandura ivyaremwe vyose.
Umunywamazi niwaboneka mu bicu, nzowubona maze nibuke isezerano ridata igihe hagati y’Imana n’ivyaremwe vyose biri kw’isi.”
Imana ibwira Nowa iti: “Iki ni co kimenyetso c’isezerano ngiraniye namwe hamwe n’ivyaremwe vyose biri kw’isi.”
Abahungu ba Nowa bavanye na we mu bwato ni Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti. Hamu ni we sekuruza wa Kanani.
Aba ni bo bahungu batatu ba Nowa, kandi abantu bose bakwiragiye kw’isi bakomotse kuri bo.
Inyuma y’umwuzure, Nowa yabaye umurimyi maze atera uruzabibu.
Umusi umwe Nowa anywa umuvinyu yari yaganye, araborerwa maze aryama atambaye mw’ihema ryiwe.
Hamu, sekuruza wa Kanani, abonye ko se ari gusa, arasohoka abibwira abavukanyi biwe.
Nuko Shemu na Yafeti bafatira impuzu ku bitugu vyabo, bagenza umugongo binjira mw’ihema, bapfuka se. Binjiye bagenza umugongo kugira ngo ntibabone ubwambure bwa se.
Nowa yikanguye atakiborewe akamenya ivyo umuhererezi wiwe yakoze,
aravuga ati: “Kanani aravumwe! Azobera bene se umugurano ari inyuma y’abandi.”
Yongerako ati: “ Uhoraho Imana ya Shemu iragahezagirwa! Kanani aze amubere umugurano.
Imana ize yagure amatongo ya Yafeti; Yafeti aze yibere mu mahema ya Shemu, Kanani aze amubere umugurano.”
Inyuma y’umwuzure, Nowa yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana atatu na mirongo itanu.
Imyaka yose Nowa yabayeho ni amajana icenda na mirongo itanu, hanyuma arapfa.
Uru ni rwo rukurikirane rw’imiryango ya Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti, abahungu batatu ba Nowa, na bo bakaba bavyaye abahungu inyuma y’umwuzure.
Bene Yafeti ni: Gomeri, Magogi, Madayi, Yavani, Tubali, Mesheki na Tirasi.
Bene Gomeri ni: Ashikenazi, Rifati na Togaruma.
Bene Yavani ni: Elisa, Tarushishi, Kitimu na Dodanimu.
Ababakomotseko babaye ku biyaga ni na bo bakwiragiye mu bihugu bitandukanye, umwumwe wese bijanye n’ururimi rwiwe, ubwoko bwiwe n’igihugu ciwe.
Bene Hamu ni: Kushi, Egiputa, Puti na Kanani.
Bene Kushi ni: Seba, Havila, Sabuta, Rama na Sabuteka. Abahungu ba Rama ni: Sheba na Dedani.
Kushi yavyaye Nimurodi, uwo ni we yatanguye kuba umuhizi mu ntambara kw’isi.

Kubera ko yari umuhigi w’umunyenkomezi wa mbere kw’isi, izina ryiwe ryabaye rurangiranwa. Ni co gituma abantu bavuga bati: “Uwu muntu ameze nka Nimurodi, wa muhigi w’umunyenkomezi mu maso y’ Uhoraho .”
Ibisagara vya mbere vy’ubwami bwiwe vyari Babiloni, Ereki, Akadi na Kalune mu gihugu ca Shinari.
Avuye aho, yahavuye yagura ubwami bwiwe ashika muri Ashuri, yubaka Ninewe, Rehoboti Iru, Kala,
na Reseni, igisagara kinini kiri hagati ya Ninewe na Kala.
Abakomotse kuri Egiputa ni Abaludi, Abanami, Abalehabi, Abanafutuhi,
Abapatirusi n’Abakasiluni (ari bo bakomotsweko n’Abafilisitiya), hamwe n’Abakafutori.
Kanani yavyaye Sidoni, ari we mfura yiwe, hamwe na Heti.
Kandi yakomotsweko n’Abayebusi, Abamori, Abagirugashi,
Abahiwi, Abaruki, Abasini
Abaruvadi, Abazemari n’Abahamati. Mu nyuma imiryango y’Abanyakanani yahavuye isanzara.
Imbibe z’igihugu c’i Kanani zava i Sidoni mu buraruko bwa Gerari n’i Gaza mu bumanuko, na Sodomu, Gomora, Adima na Zeboyimu mu buseruko, gushika i Lasha.
Aba ni bo bahungu ba Hamu, uko imiryango yabo, indimi zabo, intara zabo n’ibihugu vyabo biri.
Shemu, mukuru wa Yafeti, na we yavyaye abahungu; ni we sekuruza w’abakomoka kuri Eberi.
Bene Shemu ni: Elamu, Ashuri, Arupakisade, Ludi na Aramu.
Abahungu ba Aramu ni: Uzi, Huli, Geteri na Mesheki.
Arupakisade yavyaye Shela; Shela na we avyara Eberi.
Eberi yavyaye abahungu babiri: umwe yitwa Pelegi, kuko igihe yavuka abantu bari kw’isi bari bigabuyemwo ibice; uwundi bavukana yitwa Yokitani.
Yokitani yavyaye Alumodadi, Shelefu, Hazarumaveti, Yera,
Hadoramu, Uzali, Dikula,
Obali, Abimayeli, Sheba,
Ofiru, Havila, na Yobabu. Abo bose bari abahungu ba Yokitani.
Igihugu babamwo cahera i Mesha gushika i Sefaru mu misozi yo mu buseruko.
Aba ni bo bakomotse kuri Shemu, nk’uko imiryango yabo, indimi zabo, intara zabo n’ibihugu vyabo biri.
Iyo ni yo miryango yakomotse ku bahungu ba Nowa nk’uko imiryango yabo mu bihugu vyabo iri. Amahanga yose yo mw’isi yakomotse kuri iyi miryango inyuma y’umwuzure.
Muri ico gihe, abantu bose baba kw’isi bavuga ururimi rumwe, bagakoresha n’amajambo amwe.
Bamaze kwimukira mu buseruko, basanga ikiyaya mu gihugu ca Shinari, baca bagereraho.
Nuko baravugana bati: “Nimuze tubumbe amatafari tuyaturire neza.” Muri ico gihugu bubakisha amatafari mu gishingo c’amabuye n’ikaburimbi mu gishingo c’isima n’umusenyi.
Baravuga bati: “Nimuze twiyubakire igisagara gifise umunara ushika mw’ijuru. Ivyo bitume tumenyekana cane kandi bitume tudashwiragira kw’isi yose.”
Maze Uhoraho amanukanwa no kuraba ico gisagara n’umunara abo bantu bariko barubaka.
Aravuga ati: “Aba bantu bagiye hamwe kandi bavuga ururimi rumwe. Ko batanguye gukora ibi, nta kintu na kimwe bazoshaka gukora kizobananira.
Reka tumanuke dutume haba indimi nyinshi, maze bazazanirwe vyanke ko bumvikana.”
Uko ni ko Uhoraho yabashwiragirije kw’isi yose, bituma batabandanya kwubaka ca gisagara.
Ni co gituma ico gisagara ciswe Babeli, kuko aho ni ho Uhoraho yateye abantu kuzazanirwa kubera indimi nyinshi, maze abashwiragiza kw’isi yose.
Uru ni rwo rukurikirane rw’abagize umuryango wa Shemu. Shemu amaze imyaka ijana, aca avyara Arupakisade; aho hari haheze imyaka ibiri inyuma y’umwuzure.
Arupakisade amaze kuvuka, Shemu yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana atanu, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Arupakisade amaze imyaka mirongo itatu n’itanu, yavyaye Shela.
Shela amaze kuvuka, Arupakisade yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana ane n’itatu, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Shela amaze imyaka mirongo itatu, yavyaye Eberi.
Eberi amaze kuvuka, Shela yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana ane n’itatu, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Eberi amaze imyaka mirongo itatu n’ine, yavyaye Pelegi.
Pelegi amaze kuvuka, Eberi yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana ane na mirongo itatu, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Pelegi amaze imyaka mirongo itatu, yavyaye Rewu.
Rewu amaze kuvuka, Pelegi yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana abiri n’icenda, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Rewu amaze imyaka mirongo itatu n’ibiri yavyaye Serugi.
Serugi amaze kuvuka, Rewu yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana abiri n’indwi, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Serugi amaze imyaka mirongo itatu, yavyaye Nahori.
Nahori amaze kuvuka, Serugi yabayeho iyindi myaka amajana abiri, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Nahori amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’icenda, yavyaye Tera.
Tera amaze kuvuka, Nahori yabayeho iyindi myaka ijana na cumi n’icenda, ayivyaramwo abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Tera amaze imyaka mirongo indwi, yavyaye Aburamu, Nahori na Harani.
Uru ni rwo rukurikirane rw’abagize umuryango wa Tera. Tera yavyaye Aburamu, Nahori na Harani. Harani na we yavyaye Loti.
Ariko Harani yapfiriye muri Uri mu Bakaludaya, mu gihugu ciwe c’amavukiro, se Tera akiriho.
Maze Aburamu na Nahori na bo bararongora. Umugore wa Aburamu yitwa Sarayi; umugore wa Nahori na we yitwa Milika, akaba yari umukobwa wa Harani, uwo Harani ni we yari se wa Isika kandi.
Sarayi yari ingumba, ntiyashobora kuronka umwana.

Umusi umwe Tera ava muri Uri mu Bakaludaya aja i Kanani ajanye na Aburamu umuhungu wiwe, n’umwuzukuru wiwe Loti, umuhungu wa Harani, hamwe n’umukazana wiwe Sarayi, umugore wa Aburamu. Ariko bashitse i Harani, baca bagereraho.
Tera yamaze imyaka amajana abiri n’itanu, hanyuma apfira i Harani.

headings.text: Kuva kuri Shemu gushika kuri Aburamu

verses.text: Maze Uhoraho abwira Aburamu ati: “Va mu gihugu cawe, mu bwoko bwawe no mu muryango wa so, uje mu gihugu nzokwereka.
Nzokugira ihanga rikomeye kandi nzoguhezagira; izina ryawe nzorigira rurangiranwa, kandi uzobera abandi umuhezagiro.
Abazoguhezagira nzobahezagira, kandi abazokuvuma nzobavuma; imiryango yose yo kw’isi izohezagirwa biciye kuri wewe.”
Nuko Aburamu aca aragenda nk’uko Uhoraho yamutegetse ajana n’umuhungwabo Loti. Igihe yava i Harani, Aburamu yari amaze imyaka mirongo indwi n’itanu.
Nuko agenda ajanye n’umugore wiwe Sarayi, n’umuhungwabo Loti, n’ibintu vyose bari batunze hamwe n’abantu bose bari baronkeye i Harani, maze berekeza mu gihugu c’i Kanani, baragenda bashikayo.
Aburamu aca muri ico gihugu ashika ahitwa i Shekemu, ku giti kinini ca More. Muri ico gihe, Abanyakanani ni bo baba muri ico gihugu.
Hanyuma Uhoraho yiyereka Aburamu, aramubwira ati: “Uruvyaro rwawe nzoruha iki gihugu.” Aburamu aca yubakira Uhoraho yamwiyeretse igicaniro aho hantu.
Inyuma y’aho, Aburahamu yerekeza mu bumanuko, ashinga amahema mu misozi yaho. Mu burengero hari Beteli, mu buseruko hakaba Hayi. Aho na ho ahubakira Uhoraho ikindi gicaniro, maze asenga Uhoraho .
Hanyuma Aburamu arabandanya aja mu bumanuko, agenda aracumbika, atumbereye i Negebu.
Hanyuma muri ico gihe hatera inzara ikomeye muri ico gihugu, bituma Aburamu aja kuba muri Egiputa ahamara igihe.
Bagira bashike muri Egiputa, Aburamu abwira umugore wiwe Sarayi ati: “Ndazi ko uri umugore mwiza cane.
Abanyegiputa nibakubona bazovuga bati: ‘Uwu ni umugore wiwe.’ Bazoca banyica, ariko wewe bakureke ubeho.
Ndagusavye rero uze ubabwire ko uri mushikanje; ivyo bizotuma bamfata neza ntibanyice kubera wewe.”
Aburamu ashitse muri Egiputa, Abanyegiputa babona ko umugore wiwe ari mwiza cane.
Abaganwa ba Farawo bamubonye na bo babwira Farawo ubwiza bwiwe. Maze baca bajana Sarayi ku kirimba c’umwami.
Ivyo vyatumye umwami afata Aburamu neza amuha intama, impene, inka, indogoba z’ingabo n’ingore, abakozi b’abahungu n’abakobwa n’ingamiya, ku bwa Sarayi.
Ariko Uhoraho ateza Farawo n’umuryango wiwe ivyago bitandukanye kubera Sarayi, umugore wa Aburamu.
Nuko Farawo atumako Aburamu aramubaza ati: “Ibi wankoreye ni ibiki? Ni kuki utambwiye ko ari umugore wawe?
Ni kuki wavuze ngo ni mushikawe, bigatuma ndamugira umugore wanje? Ubu rero, ng’uwo umugore wawe. Mwakire muce muva aha mugende!”
Nuko Farawo ategeka bamwe mu bakozi biwe kwirukana Aburamu, bamurungikana n’umugore wiwe n’ivyo yari atunze vyose.
Nuko Aburamu ava muri Egiputa asubira i Negebu, ari kumwe n’umugore wiwe Sarayi, n’umuhungwabo Loti, n’ivyo bari batunze vyose.
Ico gihe Aburamu yari afise ibitungwa vyinshi, n’ifeza n’inzahabu.
Nuko ava ni Negebu, agenda aracumbika, ashika i Beteli, muri ca kibanza cari hagati ya Beteli na Hayi, aho yari yarashinze amahema ubwa mbere.
Aho ni ho Aburamu yari yarubatse igicaniro, akahasengera Uhoraho .
Loti, umwe yagumye agendana na Aburamu, na we yari afise ibitungwa bininibinini na bitobito hamwe n’amahema.
Ariko aho hantu bari ntihashobora kubakwira bari kumwe, kuko ivyo bari batunze vyari vyinshi bituma badashobora kugumana.
Nuko haduka impari hagati y’abungere b’imikuku ya Aburamu n’ab’imikuku ya Loti. Muri ico gihe, Abanyakanani n’Abaperizi ni bo baba muri ico gihugu.
Aburamu abwira Loti ati: “Ntihakwiye kuba impari hagati y’abungere bawe n’abanje, kuko turi incuti.
Igihugu cose kiri imbere yawe. Ndakwinginze tuvane. Niwahitamwo i bubamfu, ndaja i buryo; niwahitamwo i buryo, ndaja i bubamfu.”

Nuko Loti yunamura amaso araba ikiyaya ca Yorodani yerekeye i Zowari. Ako karere karimwo inzuzi nyinshi, nk’itongo ry’ Uhoraho canke nk’igihugu ciza ca Egiputa. Aho hari imbere y’uko Uhoraho arandura ibisagara vya Sodomu na Gomora.
Maze Loti yihitiramwo ikiyaya cose ca Yorodani agenda atumbereye mu buseruko. Uko ni ko bavanye.
Nuko Aburamu ahitamwo kuba mu gihugu c’i Kanani, Loti na we aja kuba mu bisagara vyo muri ca kiyaya, ashinga amahema yiwe hafi y’i Sodomu.
Abantu b’i Sodomu bakora ibibi vyinshi kandi bacumura k’ Uhoraho .
Loti amaze kugenda, Uhoraho abwira Aburamu ati: “Unamura amaso yawe uhereye aha uri, urabe mu mihingo yose: mu buraruko, mu bumanuko, mu buseruko no mu burengero.
Iki gihugu cose ubona nzokiguha wewe n’uruvyaro rwawe kibe icanyu ibihe vyose.
Uruvyaro rwawe nzorugwiza nk’umukungugu wo kw’isi ku buryo ata muntu azoshobora kubaharura.
Gendagenda mu gihugu cose, kuko ndakikugabiye.”
Nuko Aburamu yimura amahema yiwe aja kuba i Heburoni hafi y’ibiti binini vya Mamure. Aho na ho ahubakira Uhoraho igicaniro.
Muri ico gihe, haduka intambara muri ako karere. Amurafeli umwami w’i Shinari, Ariyoki umwami w’i Elasari, Kedolawoma umwami w’i Elamu na Tidali umwami w’i Goyimu;
bose batera Bera umwami w’i Sodomu, Birusha umwami w’i Gomora, Shinabu umwami w’i Adima, Shemeberi umwami w’i Zeboyimu, n’umwami w’i Bela, ari ho Zowari.
Abo bami batanu bagize urunani bashira inguvu zabo hamwe mu kiyaya ca Sidimu, ari co kiyaya c’Ikiyaga c’Umunyu.
Bari bamaze imyaka icumi n’ibiri bakorera umwami Kedolawoma, maze mu mwaka ugira icumi na gatatu baramugarariza.
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kane, umwami Kedolawoma azanana n’abami bafatanije na we batera Abarefayimu i Ashiteroti-Karunayimu, n’Abazuzi i Hamu, n’Abamiti i Shave Kiriyatayimu,
n’Abahori babaneshereza iwabo ku musozi Seyiri, babashitsa i Eliparani aho ubugaragwa bugarukira.
Maze basubira inyuma baja ahitwa Eni-Mishipati, ari ho Kadeshi, bigarurira igihugu cose c’Abamaleki, hamwe n’ic’Abamori baba i Hazazoni-Tamari.
Hanyuma umwami w’i Sodomu, uw’i Gomora, uw’i Adima, uw’i Zeboyimu n’uw’i Bela, ari ho i Zowari, barahagaruka baja hamwe bitegurira ingwano mu kiyaya c’i Sidimu
bahangana na Kedolawoma umwami w’i Elamu, na Tidali umwami w’i Goyimu, na Amurafeli umwami w’i Shinari na Ariyoki umwami w’i Elasari; abo bami bane bahangana na batanu.
Ikiyaya c’i Sidimu cari cuzuye ibinogo vyimbwemwo ikaburimbi, maze ingabo z’abami b’i Sodomu n’i Gomora bariko barahunga, bamwe muri bo bakorokera muri vya binogo, abandi na bo bahungira ku misozi.
Nuko ba bami bane baratsinda, begeranya ubutunzi bwose bw’i Sodomu n’i Gomora, n’ivyimburwa vyabo vyose barabijana.
Bajana na Loti wa muhungwabo na Aburamu yaba i Sodomu hamwe n’ivyiwe vyose.
Umwe mu bari bacitse kw’icumu araza abibwira Aburamu Umuheburayo, yaba hafi y’ibiti binini vya Mamure Umumori, yavukana na Eshikoli na Aneri; kandi abo bari bafatanije na Aburamu.
Aburamu yumvise ko umuhungwabo yagizwe imbohe, yegeranya abagabo amajana atatu na cumi n’umunani bavukiye iwe kandi bigishijwe ivyo kugwana, maze akurikira ba bami bane gushika i Dani.
Ahashitse agabura abantu biwe mu migwi, abatera mw’ijoro; maze anesha abo bami, arabakurikirana gushika i Hoba mu buraruko bw’i Damasiko.
Aburamu yegeranya ibintu vyose vyari vyibwe, agarukana n’umuhungwabo Loti hamwe n’ivyiwe vyose, n’abagore bose hamwe n’abandi bantu.
Aburamu atabarutse ahejeje kunesha umwami Kedolawoma n’abami bari bafatanije, umwami w’i Sodomu aza kumusanganira mu kiyaya c’i Shave, ari co bita ikiyaya c’umwami.
Maze Melekisedeki umwami w’i Salemu, akaba n’umuherezi w’Imana Musumbavyose amuzanira imikate n’umuvinyu.
Ahezagira Aburamu avuga ati: “Aburamu aragahezagirwa n’Imana Musumbavyose, yaremye ijuru n’isi.
Kandi iragahezagirwa Imana Musumbavyose, yaguhaye kunesha abansi bawe.” Nuko Aburamu aha Melekisedeki ica cumi c’ivyo yari afise vyose.
Umwami w’i Sodomu abwira Aburamu ati: “Ndagusavye umpe abantu, ariko ugumane ibintu wagaruye.”
Aburamu aramwishura ati: “Ndakurahiye imbere y’ Uhoraho , Imana Musumbavyose, yaremye ijuru n’isi,
ko ata kintu na kimwe cawe ntwara, n’aho koba akanyuzi canke umugozi w’ikirato, kugira ngo ntuzohave uvuga uti: ‘Ni jewe natungishije Aburamu.’
Jewe nta kintu na kimwe ntwara uretse ivyo abantu banje bariye. Ariko abo dufatanije Aneri, Eshikoli na Mamure barashobora kwakira imigabane yabo.”
Hanyuma y’ivyo Uhoraho avugana na Aburamu mu ndoto ati: “Aburamu, ntugire ubwoba. Ni jewe nzogukingira, kandi ni jewe nzoguha impera ikomeye.”
Ariko Aburamu arishura ati: “Uhoraho Nyeninganji, mbega imihezagiro yose wompa yomarira iki, ko ntagira umwana? Uwugiye kuragwa ivyanje vyose ni Eliyezeri umukozi wanje ava i Damasiko.”
Aburamu yongerako ati: “Erega nta ruvyaro wampaye, ni co gituma umwe mu bakozi banje ari we agiye kuba samuragwa wanje.”
Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Oya, si umukozi wawe azokubera samuragwa, ahubwo umuhungu wawe bwite ni we azokubera samuragwa.”
Maze Uhoraho ajana Aburamu hanze aramubwira ati: “Raba kw’ijuru uharure inyenyeri nimba wobishobora. Uko ni ko uruvyaro rwawe ruzongana!”
Nuko Aburamu yizera Uhoraho , bituma Uhoraho amwemera nk’umugororotsi.
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Ndi Uhoraho nagukuye muri Uri mu Bakaludaya kugira ngo ndaguhe iki gihugu kibe iragi ryawe.”
Ariko Aburamu aramubaza ati: “ Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ni igiki conyemeza ko iki gihugu kizoba icanje?”
Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Nzanira ishashi y’inka, ishashi y’impene n’impfizi y’intama; vyose bimaze imyaka itatu; uzane n’intunguru hamwe n’inuma ikiri nto.”
Aburamu azana vya bikoko, abihimburamwo kubiri, maze igihimba cose agitumberanya na kigenzi caco, ariko za nyoni ntiyazihimburamwo kubiri.
Nuko ibinyoni bikunda inyama biza aho ya mivyimba iri, ariko Aburamu akaguma avyirukana.
Izuba rigiye kurenga, Aburamu afatwa n’itiro ryinshi cane, maze umwijima w’umuzitanya uteye ubwoba uramuhwikira.
Uhoraho aca abwira Aburamu ati: “Umenye neza ko abagukomokako bazoba abanyamahanga mu gihugu kitari icabo. Bazoba abagurano muri ico gihugu imyaka amajana ane.
Ariko nzohana igihugu kizobagira abagurano, kandi mu nyuma bazokivamwo bafise ubutunzi bwinshi.
Ariko wewe uzoramba wipfire ushaje kandi mu mahoro, uhamvye ba sogokuruza.
Ku runganwe rugira kane, uruvyaro rwawe ruzogaruka muri kino gihugu, kuko ivyaha vy’Abamori ntibiraba vyinshi kugira ngo ndabirukane mu gihugu.”
Izuba rimaze kurenga hakaza umwijima, haza inkono yo gucaniramwo ifumba umwotsi n’ikimuri caka bica hagati ya vya bihimba vy’imivyimba.
Uwo musi Uhoraho agirana isezerano na Aburamu avuga ati: “Iki gihugu ndagihaye uruvyaro rwawe, kuva ku ruzi rwa Egiputa gushika ku ruzi runini Efurate.
Ni igihugu c’Abakayini, Abakenizi, Abakadimoni,
Abaheti, Abaperizi, Abarefayimu,
Abamori, Abanyakanani, Abagirugashi n’Abayebusi.”
Sarayi muka Aburamu, ntiyari bwashobore kuvyarana na we umwana. Ariko yari afise incoreke y’Umunyegiputakazi yitwa Hagari.

Nuko Sarayi abwira Aburamu ati: “ Uhoraho ntiyashatse ko ndonka umwana. None genda uryamane n’umuguranokazi wanje. Hari n’aho vyokunda nkaronka abana biciye kuri we.” Nuko Aburamu yumvira Sarayi umugore wiwe.
Sarayi umugore wa Aburamu afata Hagari ya ncoreke y’Umunyegiputakazi, umuha Aburamu umugabo wiwe nk’umugore. Ivyo vyabaye Aburamu amaze imyaka icumi aba mu gihugu c’i Kanani.
Nuko Aburamu aryamana na Hagari, na we aca asama inda. Hagari amaze kumenya ko yibungenze, atangura gusuzugura inabuja Sarayi.

Sarayi abwira Aburamu ati: “Nimba ndiko ndasuzugurwa ni ikosa ryawe! Naguhaye incoreke yanje nk’umugore, none amaze kubona ko yibungenze, aratanguye kunsuzugura. Uhoraho ni we akwiye guca urubanza hagati yanje nawe!”
Aburamu aramwishura ati: “None ko ari incoreke yawe, mugirire ico ushaka.” Nuko Sarayi aca atangura gufata Hagari nabi cane ku buryo ahava akiyomora.
Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho araza asanga Hagari hafi y’iriba mu bugaragwa; iryo riba ryari hafi y’inzira ija i Shuri.
Aramubaza ati: “Hagari, ncoreke ya Sarayi, uva he, ukaja he?” Aramwishura ati: “Ndiko ndahunga mabuja Sarayi.”
Wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Subira kwa nyokobuja, uce bugufi imbere yiwe.”
Yongerako ati: “Nzogwiza uruvyaro rwawe ku buryo rutazoharurika.”
Wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho yongera aramubwira ati: “Uribungenze, kandi uzovyara umuhungu. Uze umwite Ishimayeli, kuko Uhoraho yumvise ijwi ry’umubabaro wawe.
Uwo mwana azomera nk’indogoba y’inyeshamba; azohangana n’abantu bose kandi abantu bose bazohangana na we, kandi azokwankana n’abavukanyi biwe bose.”
Hanyuma y’ivyo, Hagari yita izina Uhoraho yari ahejeje kuvugana na we. Aravuga ati: “Uri Eli Royi, Imana imbona,” kuko yavuga ati: “Ni ivy’ukuri ndabonye Imana y’indavyi.”
Ni co gituma iryo riba baryise Beyeri-Lahayi-Royi bisigura “Iriba ry’Imana nzima imbona”. Iryo riba riri hagati ya Kadeshi na Beredi.
Nuko Hagari avyarana na Aburamu umuhungu, Aburahamu aca amwita Ishimayeli.
Ico gihe Hagari yavyara Ishimayeli, Aburamu yari afise imyaka mirongo umunani n’itandatu.
Aburamu amaze imyaka mirongo icenda n’icenda, Uhoraho aramwiyereka amubwira ati: “Ndi Imana Mushoboravyose; gendera imbere yanje mu bwizigirwa kandi ubeho ubuzima butagira umugayo.
Nzogirana isezerano nawe kandi nzoguha uruvyaro runini.”
Aburamu avyumvise yikubita hasi yubamye. Maze Imana aramubwira iti:
“Iri ni ryo sezerano ngiranye nawe: nzokugira sekuruza w’amahanga menshi.
Kandi kuva ubu ntuzosubira kwitwa Aburamu, uzokwitwa Aburahamu, kuko ndakugize sekuruza w’amahanga menshi.
Nzoguha kurondoka cane. Uruvyaro rwawe ruzovamwo amahanga menshi, kandi muri bo hazovamwo abami.
Nzokomeza isezerano hagati yawe nanje no hagati yanje n’uruvyaro rwawe ribe isezerano ridahera, uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi. Nzoba Imana yawe n’Imana y’uruvyaro rwawe.
Igihugu cose c’i Kanani, ico ubamwo ubu nk’umunyamahanga, nzokiguha wewe n’uruvyaro rwawe kibe icanyu bwegu ibihe vyose, kandi nzobabera Imana.”
Imana yongera ibwira Aburahamu iti: “Wewe n’uruvyaro rwawe mubwirizwa kwubahiriza iri sezerano, uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi.
Iri ni ryo sezerano ryanje wewe n’uruvyaro rwawe mubwirizwa kwubahiriza: umuhungu wese ategerezwa gukebwa.
Mutegerezwa gukebwa, kandi ico kizoba ikimenyetso c’isezerano ngiranye namwe.

Uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikira urundi, umuhungu wese atagerezwa gukebwa amaze imisi umunani avutse, utibagiye n’abagurano bazovukira mu rugo rwawe canke abo uzogura amahera mu banyamahanga, abazoba batari abo mu ruvyaro rwawe.
Baba abavukiye mu rugo rwawe canke abo waguze amahera, bose bategerezwa gukebwa. Imibiri yanyu izogaragarako icerekana isezerano ryanje ridahera.
Umuhungu wese atazokebwa, azocibwa mu bwoko bwiwe, kuko azoba atubahirije isezerano ryanje.”
Hanyuma Imana ibwira Aburahamu iti: “Sarayi umugore wawe ntuzosubire kumwita Sarayi, kuva ubu uzomwite Sara.
Nzomuhezagira kandi nzoguha umuhungu nciye kuri we. Nzomuhezagira kandi azoba nyina w’amahanga; abami n’amahanga menshi bazokomoka kuri we.”
Nuko Aburahamu yikubita hasi yubamye, aratwenga yivugana mu mutima ati: “Mbe umuntu w’imyaka ijana nkanje yoba akivyara umwana? Mbe Sara yoba akivyara umwana amaze imyaka mirongo icenda?”
Maze Aburahamu abwira Imana ati: “Icompa Ishimayeli akagira umuhezagiro wawe!”
Imana iravuga iti: “Oya, Sara umugore wawe azokuvyarira umwana w’umuhungu, uze umwite Isaka. Nzokomeza isezerano ryanje na we n’uruvyaro rwiwe, ribe isezerano ridahera.

Ku bijanye na Ishimayeli, numvise ico wasavye: nzomuhezagira, nzomuha kurondoka cane, ntume uruvyaro rwiwe rugwira cane. Azoba sekuruza w’abakuru b’imiryango icumi na babiri, kandi uruvyaro rwiwe ruzoba ihanga rikomeye.
Ariko isezerano ryanje nzorikomeza kuri Isaka, uwo Sara azokuvyarira igihe nk’iki mu mwaka uza.”
Imana ihejeje kuvugana na Aburahamu ica ivana na we iragenda.
Uwo musi nyene Aburahamu afata umuhungu wiwe Ishimayeli n’umugabo wese yaba mu rugo rwiwe, harimwo abahavukiye n’abo yaguze amahera, arabakeba nk’uko Imana yari yamubwiye.
Aburahamu yari amaze imyaka mirongo icenda n’icenda igihe yakebwa.
Ishimayeli, umuhungu wiwe, yari amaze imyaka icumi n’itatu igihe yakebwa.
Aburahamu n’umuhungu wiwe Ishimayeli, uko ari babiri, bakebwe uwo umusi.
Umuntu wese w’igitsina gabo yaba mu rugo rwa Aburahamu, yaba uwahavukiye canke uwaguzwe amahera mu banyamahanga, na we yakebwe uwo musi hamwe na we.
Uhoraho asubira kwiyereka Aburahamu ku biti binini vya Mamure yicaye mu muryango w’ihema ryiwe. Muri uwo mwanya hari hashushe cane.
Aburahamu yunamura amaso araraba, maze abona abagabo batatu bahagaze hafi yiwe. Ababonye ava mu muryango w’ihema yiruka kubasanganira, yikubita hasi imbere yabo yubamye.
Aravuga ati: “Ba nyakwubahwa, nimba ngiriwe ubuntu imbere yanyu, ndabasavye mushike iwanje, jewe umusavyi wanyu.
Munkundire ndabazanire amazi makeya mwoge ibirenge, hanyuma muruhukire musi y’igiti.
Kandi ko mwangiriye ubuntu jewe umusavyi wanyu mugashika iwanje, munkundire ndabazimane, kugira ngo mugire intege zo kubandanya urugendo.” Na bo baramwishura bati: “Bikore nk’uko ubivuze.”
Nuko Aburahamu yinjira yihuta mw’ihema aho Sara yari ari aramubwira ati: “Nyarutsa ufate ingero seya zitatu z’ifu ya mbere nziza, ugire igikandu hanyuma ukore imikate.”
Hanyuma Aburahamu yiruka iyo imikuku yari iri afata inyana nini ivyibushe, ayiha umwe mu bakozi biwe, na we yihutira kuyitegura.
Maze Aburahamu azana amata y’urubu, ay’ifyufyu n’inyama za ya nyana bateguye, abizimana ba bagabo. Bariko bararya, Aburahamu ahagarara hafi yabo musi y’igiti.
Baramubaza bati: “Sara umugore wawe ari he?” Na we arabishura ati: “Ari aho mw’ihema.”

Maze umwe muri bo aravuga ati: “Nzogaruka iwawe igihe nk’iki umwaka uza, kandi Sara umugore wawe azoba afise umwana w’umuhungu.” Muri ako kanya, Sara yari mu muryango w’ihema ryari inyuma y’uwariko aravuga yumviriza.
Aburahamu na Sara bari bakuze cane, kandi Sara yari yararengeje imyaka yo kuvyara.
Nuko Sara aratwenga yivugana ati: “Ko ndi akaheze, n’umwami wanje na we akaba ashaje, mbega ivyo vyoba bikindyohera?”
Uhoraho abaza Aburahamu ati: “Ni kuki Sara atwenze akavuga ati: ‘Mbega umutamakazi nkanje noba nkironka umwana?’
Mbega hari ikintu kidashobokera Uhoraho ? Aho nzogarukira igihe nk’iki umwaka uza, Sara azoba afise umwana w’umuhungu.”
Nuko Sara agira ubwoba, arahakana ati: “Sinatwenze.” Ariko Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Watwenze koko.”
Hanyuma ba bagabo bava aho, bagenda batumbereye i Sodomu. Aburahamu ajana na bo abaherekeje.
Uhoraho aribwira ati: “Mbega noshobora guhisha Aburahamu ico nshaka gukora?
Ehe agiye kuba sekuruza w’ihanga rinini kandi amahanga yose yo kw’isi azohezagirwa biciye kuri we.

Naramuhisemwo kugira ngo arongore abana biwe n’abo mu nzu yiwe n’abazovuka inyuma yiwe, kugira ngo bagendere mu nzira z’ Uhoraho bakore ibigororotse kandi bace imanza ziroranye, kugira ngo nzoshitse kuri Aburahamu ivyo namusezeraniye.”
Nuko Uhoraho abwira Aburahamu ati: “Urwamo rwagiriza Sodomu na Gomora ni rwinshi cane kandi ivyaha vyabo birateye ubwoba.
Manutse kuraba ko ivyo bakoze bijanye n’urwamo rwanshikiriye, biba vyo bitaba vyo, ndabimenya.”
Ba bagabo barahindukira bagenda batumbereye i Sodomu, ariko Aburahamu aguma ahagaze imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Aburahamu aramwegera aramubaza ati: “None ugiye kurandurana abagororotsi n’abanyakibi?
Hamwe wosanga hariyo abantu mirongo itanu b’abagororotsi muri kirya gisagara, na ho nyene wokirandura; ntiwogihangaza ku bwabo?

Oya ntiwokora ikintu gisa n’ico; ntiworandura abagororotsi hamwe n’abanyakibi; ngo umugororotsi afatwe co kimwe n’umunyakibi. Ivyo ntibikabe! Mbega Umucamanza w’isi yose ntakwiye gukora ibigororotse?”
Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Ninasanga hari abagororotsi mirongo itanu i Sodomu, igisagara cose ndagihangaza ku bwabo.”
Aburahamu arabandanya ati: “Umpangaze, nubahutse kuvugana n’Imana kandi ndi umukungugu n’umunyota.

Mbega hamwe wosanga ari mirongo ine na batanu, badashika mirongo itanu, na ho nyene worandura igisagara cose kubera abo batanu babuze?” Uhoraho arishura ati: “Ninasanga hari abagororotsi mirongo ine na batanu i Sodomu, sindakirandura.”
Aburahamu yongera kubaza ati: “Hamwe ho wosanga ari mirongo ine gusa?” Uhoraho arishura ati: “Na ho nyene sindakirandura ku bw’abo mirongo ine.”
Aburahamu aravuga ati: “Mwami, ndasavye ntunshavurire, umpangaze mvuge. Hamwe ho wosanga ari mirongo itatu?” Uhoraho arishura ati: “Sindabikora ninasanga ari mirongo itatu.”
Aburahamu arabandanya ati: “Umpangaze, nubahutse kuvugana n’Imana kandi. Birashoboka ko wosanga ari mirongo ibiri gusa.” Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Sindakirandura nibaba ari mirongo ibiri.”
Ubwa nyuma Aburahamu arabaza ati: “Mwami, ndasavye ntunshavurire, umpangaze mvuge rimwe gusa. Hamwe wosanga hari icumi ho?” Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Ku bw’abo icumi sindakirandura.”
Uhoraho ahejeje kuvugana na Aburahamu, abandanya inzira yiwe, Aburahamu na we asubira i muhira iwe.
Ba bamarayika bashika i Sodomu ku mugoroba, ico gihe Loti yari yicaye kw’irembo ryinjira mu gisagara ca Sodomu. Ababonye aja kubasanganira, yikubita hasi imbere yabo yubamye,

arababwira ati: “Ba nyakwubahwa, ndabinginze muze mwoge ibirenge, murare iwanje, jewe umusavyi wanyu. Ejo mu gitondo muzoheza muvyuke kare mubandanye urugendo rwanyu.” Na bo baramwishura bati: “Oya, turarara hanze, ku kibuga c’igisagara.”
Ariko Loti abandanya abinginga, na bo barateba baremera kujana na we no kurara iwe. Loti abategurira amazimano agizwe n’imikate itarimwo umwambiro, barafungura.
Ariko imbere yo kuja kuryama, abagabo bose bo muri ico gisagara ca Sodomu, abakuze n’abakiri bato, bakikuza inzu ya Loti.
Bahamagara Loti baramubwira bati: “Ba bagabo baza kurara iwawe iri joro bari he? Batuzanire tubasambanye!”
Nuko Loti arasohoka yugara umuryango ahagarara imbere y’inzu.
Arababwira ati: “Bavukanyi, ndabinginze ntimukore ikibi nk’ico!
Mfise abakobwa babiri batarigera baryamana n’umugabo. Reka abe ari bo ndabazanira mubagenze uko mushaka. Ariko ntihagire ico mugira aba bagabo, kuko ni abashitsi banje mbwirizwa kubakingira.”

Baramukankamira bati: “Tuve imbere!” Baravuga bati: “Uwu mugabo yaje muri iki gisagara ari umunyamahanga, none raba yigize umucamanza wacu. Ubu rero turagukorera ikibi gisumba ico tubakorera.” Nuko basunikira Loti hirya, begera umuryango ngo bawumene.
Ba bamarayika babiri bafata Loti ukuboko bamwinjiza mu nzu, bugara umuryango.
Maze bateza uruhumyi ba bagabo bari ku muryango, abakuze n’abato, ku buryo batashobora kubona aho umuryango uri.
Ba bamarayika babaza Loti bati: “Hari abandi bantu ufise hano, baba abakwe, abahungu, abakobwa, canke uwundi muntu w’incuti ufise muri iki gisagara? Basohore bose ubakure muri iki gisagara.
Tugira turandure iki gisagara, kuko urwamo rwagiriza abantu baba muri co rwabaye rwinshi cane imbere y’ Uhoraho , ni co gituma yadutumye kukirandura.”
Nuko Loti arasohoka aja kubwira abakwe bategura kurongora abakobwa biwe ati: “Nimwihute muve muri iki gisagara kuko Uhoraho agiye kukirandura!” Ariko bo babifata nk’aho ariko arafyina.
Mu gitondo kare, ba bamarayika bihutisha Loti bati: “Nyarutsa usohokane n’umugore wawe n’abakobwa bawe babiri muri kumwe kugira ngo ntimurandurwe n’igihano c’ababa muri iki gisagara!”
Loti atanguye gukwega amaguru, ba bamarayika bamufata ukuboko, we n’umugore wiwe n’abakobwa biwe babakwegera inyuma y’igisagara, kuko Uhoraho amugiriye ubuntu.

Babashikanye hanze y’igisagara, umwe muri ba bamarayika arabihanikiriza ati: “Nimuhunge! Kandi ntimuhindukire canke ngo mugire aho muhagarara muri iki kiyaya. Nimuhungire ku musozi, kugira ngo ntimuranduke.”
Loti aravuga ati: “Oya ba nyakwubahwa!
Jewe umusavyi wanyu nagiriwe ubuntu imbere yanyu kandi mwanyeretse imbabazi nyinshi mu kunkiza. Ariko rero sinohungira ku musozi, kuko ikiza cohava kiza ntarashikayo hanyuma kikampitana.
Murabona karya gasagara ko kari hafi. Ndabasavye mundeke mpungireyo; ntimubona ko ari gato? Harya nohakirira.”
Wa mumarayika aramwishura ati: “N’ico na co ndakikwemereye. Karya gasagara sindakarandura.
Ariko ihute uhungireyo kuko ata co nkora utarashikayo.” Ni co gituma ako gasagara bakise Zowari, bisigura “ahantu hato”.
Nuko Loti ashika i Zowari izuba rirashe.
Maze Uhoraho akororera kuri Sodomu na Gomora umuriro n’ibizuku vyaka bivuye mw’ijuru;
arandura ivyo bisagara vyose hamwe n’ikiyaya cose, n’abantu bose baba muri ivyo bisagara n’ibiterwa vyose.
Ariko muka Loti arahindukira araba inyuma aca acika inkingi y’umunyu.
Nuko Aburahamu azinduka kare mu gitondo aja muri ca kibanza yahagararamwo imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Maze araba muri ca kiyaya cose atumbereje amaso i Sodomu n’i Gomora abona umwotsi mwinshi upfunduka nk’umwotsi w’itanure.
Ariko igihe Imana yarandura ivyo bisagara, yagumye yibuka ico Aburahamu yayisavye, ikiza Loti ikiza caranduye ivyo bisagara vyo mu kiyaya.
Nuko Loti ava i Zowari kuko yatinya kuhaba, adugana n’abakobwa biwe babiri mu misozi, baja kuba mw’isenga.
Umukuru muri ba bakobwa abwira mutoyi ati: “Urabona ko data ashaje, kandi nta mugabo asigaye muri iki gihugu ngo aturongore nk’uko bigenda ku bandi.
Ingo duhe data umuvinyu tumuboreze, hanyuma turyamane na we kugira ngo turonke uruvyaro biciye kuri we.”
Nuko baboreza se n’umuvinyu iryo joro, maze umukobwa mukuru arinjira asambana na se. Kubera akaborerwe, Loti ntiyigeze amenya igihe yinjiriye n’igihe yasohokeye.

Umusi ukurikira, umukuru abwira mutoya wiwe ati: “Urabona ko nararanye na data iri joro. Ingo twongere tumuboreze n’iri joro na ryo, maze winjire uryamane na we kugira ngo turonke uruvyaro biciye kuri data.”
Nuko bongera kuboreza se n’umuvinyu iryo joro. Wa mukobwa mutoya arinjira aryamana na we. Kubera akaborerwe, Loti ntiyigeze amenya igihe yinjiriye n’igihe yasohokeye.
Nuko ba bakobwa ba Loti uko ari babiri basama inda batewe na se.
Umukuru avyara umwana amwita Mowabu. Ni we sekuruza w’ihanga ryitwa Abanyamowabu gushika uno musi.
Umutoya na we avyara umuhungu amwita Beni-Ami. Ni we sekuruza w’ihanga ryitwa Abamoni gushika uno musi.
Nuko Aburahamu arunguruza aja mu bumanuko ahitwa Negebu, amara igihe aba hagati y’ahitwa Kadeshi na Shuri, hanyuma yungururiza ahitwa Gerari. Akiba aho nk’umunyamahanga,
Aburahamu avuga kuri Sara, abwira abaho ati: “Ni mushikanje!” Nuko Abimeleki, umwami w’i Gerari atuma abantu gutora Sara bamujana ku kirimba iwe.
Ariko Imana yiyerekera Abimeleki mu ndoto, iramubwira iti: “Ntugenda udapfuye kubera uwo mugore wazanye, kuko afise umugabo.”
Ariko Abimeleki ntiyari bwaryamane na we. Nuko aravuga ati: “Mwami, urashobora kurandura ihanga ata co ryagirizwa?
Si Aburahamu ubwiwe yambwiye ati: ‘Ni mushikanje’? Kandi na we ubwiye yavuze ati: ‘Egome, ni musazanje.’ Ibi nabikoze ata co niyagiriza, kandi nta kibi nakoze.”
Imana imwishurira mu ndoto iti: “Egome, ndazi ko wabikoze ata co wiyagiriza, kandi ni jewe nakubujije kuncumurako. Ni co gituma ntakwemereye ko umukorako.
Ubu rero subiza uwo mugore umugabo wiwe, kuko ni uwuvugishwa n’Imana, aca agusengera kugira ngo ntupfe. Ariko nutamusubiza umugore wiwe, umenye neza ko wewe n’abawe bose muzopfa.”
Nuko Abimeleki avyuka mu gitondo, akoranya abaganwa biwe arabibabwira, na bo bagira ubwoba bwinshi.
Abimeleki ahamagara Aburahamu aramubaza ati: “Ibi wadukoreye ni ibiki? Ni ikihe kibi nagukoreye cotuma unkoresha jewe n’ubwami bwanje icaha kingana gityo? Wakoze ibidakorwa imbere yanje.”
Abimeleki abaza Aburahamu ati: “Ni igiki caguteye gukora ivyo?”
Aburahamu aramwishura ati: “Nibwiye mu mutima nti: ‘Abantu b’aha hantu ntibatinya Imana. Bazohava banyica kugira ngo batware umugore wanje.’
Ariko kandi ni mushikanje, kuko dusangiye data, ariko ntidusangiye mama; uko ni ko yabaye umugore wanje.
Igihe Imana yampamagara ngo mve mu nzu ya Data nkaba ingenzi, namubwiye nti: ‘Ndakwingize uze unyereke urukundo unkunda muri ubu buryo: ahantu hose tuzoja, uze ubwire abaho ko ndi musazawe.’ ”
Nuko Abimeleki afata intama, impene n’inka, abagurano b’abagabo n’abagore abiha Aburahamu, amusubiza na Sara umugore wiwe.
Abimeleki aramubwira ati: “Igihugu canje kiri imbere yawe; hitamwo aho ushaka kuba.”
Abwira Sara ati: “Musazawe ndamuhaye shekeli igihumbi z’ifeza. Ni ikimenyetso c’uko ata co wagirizwa imbere y’abari kumwe nawe bose. Kandi usubijwe iteka ryawe imbere ya bose.”
Nuko Aburahamu asenga Imana, na yo ikiza Abimeleki, umugore wiwe n’abagurano b’abagore biwe kugira ngo bashobore kuvyara,
kuko Uhoraho yari yamaze gutuma abagore bose bo mu nzu ya Abimeleki baba ingumba ku bwa Sara, umugore wa Aburahamu.
Umusi umwe, Uhoraho yibuka Sara, amukorera ico yari yaramusezeraniye.
Sara atwara inda, avyarana na Aburahamu umwana w’umuhungu mu butama bwiwe. Ivyo vyashitse igihe Imana yari yaravuze ko bizoberako.
Uwo mwana Aburahamu yavyaye kuri Sara amwita Isaka.
Haheze imisi umunani Isaka avutse, Aburahamu aramukeba, nk’uko Imana yari yaramutegetse.
Aburahamu yari amaze imyaka ijana igihe Isaka yavuka.
Sara aravuga ati: “Imana irantwengeje. Umuntu wese azovyumva azotwengana nanje.”
Yongerako ati: “Ni nde yobwiye Aburahamu ko Sara azokwonsa umwana? None raba ndamuvyariye umuhungu mu butama bwiwe!”
Nuko Isaka arakura hanyuma Sara aramucutsa. Umusi yacukiyeko, Aburahamu ategura umusi mukuru ukomeye.
Ariko Sara abonye Ishimayeli wa muhungu Aburahamu yavyara kuri Hagari Umunyegiputakazi ariko arakina na Isaka umwana wiwe,
aca abwira Aburahamu ati: “Irukana urya muguranokazi n’umuhungu wiwe. Umuhungu w’uwo muguranokazi ntazosangira iragi n’umwana wanje Isaka.”
Ivyo bibabaza Aburahamu cane kuko Ishimayeli na we yari umwana wiwe.
Ariko Imana ibwira Aburahamu iti: “Ntubabazwe n’ivy’urya mwana n’umuguranokazi wawe. Kora ivyo Sara akubwira vyose, kuko uruvyaro rwawe uzoruronka biciye muri Isaka.
Ariko uruvyaro rw’umuhungu w’incoreke yawe na rwo nzorugira ihanga, kuko na we ni umwana wawe.”

Bukeye, Aburahamu avyuka kare mu gitondo, ategura ivyokurya n’umukuza w’urusato wuzuye amazi abiha Hagari. Yongera afata wa mwana amushira ku mugongo wa Hagari, aramurungika. Hagari aca afata inzira, agenda arayerera mu bugaragwa bwa Berisheba.
Ya mazi yari mu mukuza w’urusato aheze, aca afata umwana amushira mu gitutu musi y’agasaka,
na we aragenda yicara hirya, nk’ahoshika umwampi urashwe, kuko yavuga ati: “Sinshaka kubona umwana wanje apfa.” Ni ko kwicara hirya maze araturika ararira.
Ariko Imana yumva ijwi rya wa mwana arira, hanyuma umumarayika w’Imana ahamagara Hagari ari mw’ijuru ati: “Ubaye iki ga Hagari? Ntutinye! Imana yumvise ijwi ry’urya mwana aririra aho ari.
Subira aho ari umuhagurutse, hanyuma umufate ukuboko, kuko uruvyaro rwiwe nzorugira ihanga rikomeye.”
Nuko Imana yugurura amaso ya Hagari, abona iriba ry’amazi. Aca aragenda yuzuza wa mukuza w’urusato amazi, aha umwana wiwe amazi yo kunywa.
Nuko Imana ibana na we mu gukura kwiwe, aba umuhinga mu kurasisha umuheto.
Yaba mu bugaragwa bw’i Parani, maze nyina amuronderera umugore ava muri Egiputa.
Muri ico gihe Abimeleki ajana na Pikoli, umukuru w’ingabo ziwe, abwira Aburahamu ati: “Biragaragara ko Imana iri kumwe nawe mu vyo ukora vyose.

Ubu rero ndashaka undahire mw’izina ry’Imana ko utazokwigera umpemukira, jewe, abana banje canke uruvyaro rwanje; ko uzonyereka ubuntu, jewe n’iki gihugu wabayemwo uri umunyamahanga, nk’uko nanje nakweretse ubuntu.”
Aburahamu aramwishura ati: “Ndakurahiye.”
Hanyuma Aburahamu yidoga ari kumwe na Abimeleki ku bijanye n’iriba abakozi ba Abimeleki bari baramutwaye ku nguvu.
Abimeleki aravuga ati: “Sinzi uwabikoze. Wewe nta co wabimbwiyeko, ndavyumvise uno musi.”
Nuko Aburahamu aha Abimeleki intama, impene n’inka; bagirana amasezerano.
Aburahamu atoranya kandi intama zivyara indwi mu mukuku wiwe.
Abimeleki aramubaza ati: “Ni kuki utoranije izo ntama mu zindi?”
Aburahamu aramwishura ati: “Ndakwinginze wakire izi ntama indwi nk’ikimenyetso c’uko ari jewe nimvye iryo riba.”
Ni co gituma aho hantu hitwa Berisheba, bisigura “iriba ry’indahiro”, kuko ari ho barahiriye uko ari babiri.
Bahejeje kugiranira amasezerano i Berisheba, Abimeleki na Pikoli, umukuru w’ingabo ziwe, baragenda basubira mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya.
Nuko Aburahamu atera igiti citwa tamarisi i Berisheba, ahasengera Uhoraho , Imana yamaho.
Aburahamu amara igihe kirekire aba muri ico gihugu c’Abafilisitiya.
Haheze igihe, Imana igerageza ukwizera kwa Aburahamu. Iramuhamagara iti: “Aburahamu!” Na we ati: “Sabwe.”
Imana iti: “Jana umuhungu wawe, umuhungu wawe w’ikinege Isaka ukunda cane, uje mu ntara ya Moriya, hanyuma umutange nk’ikimazi gituriwe ku musozi nzokwereka.”

Mu gitondo c’umusi ukurikira, Aburahamu avyuka kare, ategura indogoba yiwe, ajana babiri mu bakozi biwe, hamwe n’umuhungu wiwe Isaka. Ahejeje kwegeranya inkwi zikwiye zo guturira ikimazi, afata inzira ija aho Imana yari yamubwiye.
Ku musi ugira gatatu ari ku rugendo, Aburahamu arunamuka abona wa musozi agiyeko ukiri kure yiwe.
Aburahamu abwira ba bakozi biwe ati: “Nimugume hano n’iyi ndogoba. Jewe n’umuhungu wanje turabandanije hariya imbere. Tugiye gusenga, duhejeje duca tugaruka.”
Aburahamu ashira za nkwi zo guturira ikimazi ku rutugu rwa Isaka umuhungu wiwe, na we afata umuriro n’imbugita, babandanya urugendo ari babiri.
Isaka abwira se Aburahamu ati: “Data!” Na we ati: “Mbwira mwana wanje!” Isaka aravuga ati: “Umuriro n’inkwi turabifise, none intama yo gutangako ikimazi iri he?”
Aburahamu aramwishura ati: “Imana iraja kwironkera intama yo gutangako ikimazi, mwana wanje.” Nuko barabandanya.
Bashitse mu kibanza Imana yamubwiye, Aburahamu yubaka igicaniro, agishirako za nkwi. Hanyuma afata Isaka umuhungu wiwe aramuboha, amuryamika kuri ca gicaniro hejuru ya za nkwi.
Hanyuma agorora ukuboko atora imbugita kugira ngo akerere umuhungu wiwe.
Ariko umumarayika w’ Uhoraho amuhamagara ari mw’ijuru ati: “Aburahamu! Aburahamu!” Na we ati: “Sabwe!”
Aramubwira ati: “Ntugire ico ugira uwo mwana canke ngo umukomeretse, kuko ubu ndabonye neza ko wubaha Imana, kuko ntiwanyimye n’umwana wawe, kandi ari ikinege.”
Aburahamu yunamutse abona impfizi y’intama ifashwe amahembe mu gisaka. Nuko afata iyo ntama ayitangako ikimazi mu kibanza c’umuhungu wiwe.
Aburahamu yita aho hantu “ Uhoraho azovyizanira”. Gushika n’uno musi abantu baracavuga bati: “Ku musozi w’Imana, iravyizanira.”
Wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ahamagara Aburahamu ubugira kabiri ari mw’ijuru,
aramubwira ati: “Indahiro ni jewe nyene, ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ko wanyumviye ntunyime umwana wawe kandi ari ikinege,
nzoguhezagira vy’ukuri kandi nzogwiza uruvyaro rwawe nk’inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru canke nk’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga. Bazokwigarurira ibisagara vy’abansi babo,
kandi amahanga yose yo kw’isi azohezagirwa biciye ku ruvyaro rwawe, kuko wanyumviye.”
Nuko Aburahamu asubira hamwe yasiga ba bakozi biwe, basubirana i Berisheba, aho Aburahamu yabandanije aba.
Inyuma y’ivyo, Aburahamu yumva ko Milika, umugore wa murumunawe Nahori, yamuvyariye abahungu.
Umukuru yitwa Uzi, uwa kabiri akitwa Buzi, bagakurikirwa n’uwitwa Kemuweli, ari we se wa Aramu,
Kesedi, Hazo, Piludasho, Yidalafu na Betuweli.
Betuweli ni we yavyaye Rebeka. Abo ni bo bahungu umunani Milika yavyaranye na Nahori, murumuna wa Aburahamu.
Incoreke ya Nahori yitwa Reyuma na we yari yamuvyariye abahungu ari bo: Teba, Gahamu, Tahashi na Mayaka.
Sara yabayeho imyaka ijana na mirongo ibiri n’indwi,
hanyuma apfira i Kiriyati-Araba, ari ho Heburoni, mu gihugu c’i Kanani. Aho ni ho Aburahamu yamugandaririye, aramuririra.
Hanyuma Aburahamu ava hambavu y’ikiziga c’umugore wiwe, aja kuvugana n’abakuru b’Abaheti.
Arababwira ati: “Murazi ko ndi umunyamahanga na kavantara muri mwebwe. Ndabasavye mumpe ikibanza co guhambamwo kugira ngo mpambane iteka umugore wanje.”
Abaheti bishura Aburahamu bati:
“Nyakwubahwa, twumvirize. Wewe Imana yakugize umuganwa ahambaye muri twebwe. Hitamwo aho guhamba haruta ahandi abe ari ho umuhamba. Nta muntu n’umwe muri twebwe yokwima aho uhamba umuntu wawe.”
Aburahamu arahaguruka yunamira Abaheti baba muri ico gihugu.
Arababwira ati: “Ko munyemereye ko mpamba umugore wanje, ndabasavye munsabire Efuroni mwene Zohari,
anyemerere ndamugurire isenga afise i Makapela, aho itongo ryiwe rigarukira. Ndahamugurira ku giciro bikwiranye mwese mukoranye, maze aho hantu hambere ikibanza co guhambamwo.”
Uwo Efuroni yari yicaye aho mu bandi Baheti. Nuko yishura Aburahamu, abandi Baheti bose bari bakoraniye kw’irembo ry’igisagara bumva, ati:
“Oya nyakwubahwa, nyumviriza neza. Ndakugabiye rirya tongo n’isenga riri muri ryo. Imbere y’aba bantu bo mu bwoko bwanje ndahaguyaye. Genda uhambe uwawe.”
Aburahamu yongera yunamira abantu bo muri ico gihugu,
abwira Efuroni bose bumva ati: “Ndakwinginze nanje unyumvirize. Nyemerera ndaguhe igiciro bikwiranye na rirya tongo, kugira ngo nshobore guhamba umuntu wanje.”
Efuroni yishura Aburahamu ati:
“Nyakwubahwa, nyumviriza neza. Rirya tongo riciye shekeli amajana ane z’ifeza. None ayo mahera amaze iki hagati yanje nawe? Genda uhambe uwawe.”
Nuko Aburahamu yemera igiciro Efuroni amubwiye, amuharurira za shekeli amajana ane z’ifeza abakuru b’Abaheti bose babona.
Uko ni ko Aburahamu yaguriye itongo Efuroni i Makapela, hafi y’i Mamure. Aho yaguze hari hagizwe n’itongo, isenga n’ibiti vyari muri ryo.
Iryo tongo ryegukira Aburahamu imbere y’Abaheti bose bari bakoraniye kw’irembo ry’igisagara.
Nuko Aburahamu ahamba Sara umugore wiwe aho mw’isenga ry’i Makapela, hafi y’i Mamure (ari ho Heburoni), mu gihugu c’i Kanani.
Uko ni ko Aburahamu yahawe n’Abaheti iryo tongo n’iryo senga biba ivyiwe burundu nk’ikibanza co guhambamwo.
Ico gihe Aburahamu yari ashaje, ageze mu zabukuru, kandi Uhoraho yari yaramuhezagiye mu buryo bwose.
Umusi umwe, Aburahamu abwira umukuru mu bakozi biwe, ari we yaraba ivy’urugo rwiwe, ati: “Shira ukuboko kwawe musi y’itako ryanje,
uheze undahire mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho , Imana y’ijuru n’isi, ko utazoronderera umuhungu wanje umugore mu bakobwa b’Abanyakanani, abo mbayemwo.
Ariko uze ugende mu gihugu canje, mu ncuti zanje, abe ari ho ukura umugore wa Isaka umwana wanje.”
Wa mukozi aramubaza ati: “Nshobora kutaronka umukobwa ashaka kunkurikira ngo tuzanane muri iki gihugu. None nzoca njana umuhungu wawe Isaka mu guhugu waje uvamwo?”
Aburahamu aramwishura ati: “Oya! Uze wirinde gusubiza Isaka muri kiriya gihugu!

Uhoraho , Imana yo mw’ijuru, we yankuye mu nzu kwa data no mu gihugu canje c’amavukiro, yarambwiye arandahira ko azogabira uruvyaro rwanje iki gihugu. Azorungika umumarayika imbere yawe, kugira ngo ushobore kuronkera umuhungu wanje umugore.
Uwo mukobwa niyanka kugarukana nawe, iyi ndahiro ugira urahire ntizogufata. Ariko uze wirinde kujana umuhungu wanje muri kiriya gihugu.”
Nuko wa mukozi ashira ukuboko musi y’itako rya shebuja Aburahamu, aramurahira ko azobigenza uko.

Hanyuma afata ingamiya icumi mu za shebuja, atangura urugendo, agenda ajanye n’ingabire zitandukanye z’agaciro ahawe na shebuja, afata inzira ija ahitwa Aramu-Naharayimu, yerekeye mu gisagara Nahori murumuna wa Aburahamu yabamwo.
Ashitse kw’iriba ryari inyuma y’igisagara, apfukamika ingamiya ziwe kugira ngo zinywe amazi. Ico gihe yari amasaha abagore bazirako kuvoma.
Arasenga ati: “ Uhoraho , Mana ya databuja Aburahamu, ndakwinginze umpe kuroranirwa uwu musi. Niwereke databuja Aburahamu urukundo rwawe rudahemuka.
Mpagaze hano hambavu y’iri riba, kandi abakobwa bo mu gisagara bagira baze kuvoma.

Umukobwa nja kubwira nti: ‘Ndakwinginze uhengeke umubindi wawe, umpe amazi yo kunywa,’ na we akavuga ati: ‘Ehe nunywe kandi n’ingamiya zawe nca ndazivomera,’ uwo abe ari we watoranirije umusavyi wawe Isaka. Ico ni co kiza kunyereka ko wagiriye databuja urukundo rudahemuka.”

Ataraheza gusenga, haseruka inkumi yitwa Rebeka n’umubindi wiwe ku rutugu. Rebeka yari umukobwa wa Betuweli, uwo na we akaba yari umuhungu wa Nahori, murumuna wa Aburahamu, uwo yavyaranye n’umugore wiwe Milika.
Rebeka yari inkumi y’akaranga kandi ntiyari bwaryamane n’umugabo. Nuko aramanuka kw’iriba, yuzuza wa mubindi amazi, aca araduga.
Wa mukozi wa Aburahamu ariruka aja guhura na we, aramubwira ati: “Ndakwinginze umpe amazi yo kunywa kuri uwo mubindi wawe.”
Na we aramwishura ati: “Akira unywe, nyakwubahwa.” Nuko anyarutsa kwururutsa umubindi wiwe, kugira ngo ashobore kunywa.
Ahejeje kumuha amazi yo kunywa aramubwira ati: “Ngira mvomere n’ingamiya zawe na zo zinywe zihere inyota.”
Nuko asuka ya mazi mu bwato ibitungwa vyanyweramwo amazi, asubira kw’iriba yiruka, avomera za ngamiya ziwe zose.
Wa mukozi wa Aburahamu yitegereza ya nkumi mu gacerere, kugira ngo arabe ko Uhoraho yahezagiye urugendo rwiwe.
Za ngamiya zihejeje kunywa, wa mugabo aha wa mukobwa ihereni ry’inzahabu bambara ku zuru ripima ingero beka imwe hamwe n’ibikomo bibiri vy’inzahabu vyo kwambara ku maboko bipima shekeli icumi.
Aramubaza ati: “Mbega uri umukobwa wa nde? Ndakwinginze umbwire. Mu rugo kwa so hoba hariho aho kuturaza jewe n’abantu twagendanye?”
Na we aramwishura ati: “Ndi umukobwa wa Betuweli, uwo Milika yavyaranye na Nahori.”
Yongerako ati: “Egome iwacu hariho ivyatsi vyumye n’ivyokurya vy’izo ngamiya, kandi hariho n’aho kuraza abashitsi.”
Nuko wa mugabo arunama ahimbaza Uhoraho .
Aravuga ati: “ Uhoraho , Imana ya databuja Aburahamu, aragahezagirwa, we atibagiye kugirira databuja urukundo rudahemuka n’ubwizigirwa. Uhoraho yandongoreye mu ncuti za databuja.”
Nuko wa mukobwa ariruka aja i muhira kubabwira ibibaye vyose.
Rebeka yari afise musazawe yitwa Labani. Nuko Labani aca ariruka aja kuraba uwo mugabo kw’iriba.

Yari yamaze kubona rya hereni ryo ku zuru na vya bikomo mushikiwe yambaye ku maboko, kandi yari yumvise Rebeka avuga ivyo uwo mugabo yamubwiye. Nuko aja iyo wa mugabo ari, asanga ari kumwe n’ingamiya ziwe hambavu y’iriba.
Labani abwira wa mugabo ati: “Kaze iwacu, wewe uwahezagiwe n’ Uhoraho . Ni kuki woguma inyuma y’igisagara kandi namaze gutegura inzu n’aho kuraza ingamiya?”
Nuko wa mugabo ashika mu rugo; Labani yururutsa ivyo ingamiya zari zikoreye, arazisasira kandi arazigaburira. Azanira amazi wa mukozi wa Aburahamu n’abari bagendanye na we kugira ngo boge ibirenge.
Bamuzaniye ivyokurya, wa mukozi wa Aburahamu aravuga ati: “Sinshobora kugira ico mfunguye ntaravuga ikingenza.” Labani ati: “Tubwire.”
Aravuga ati: “Ndi umukozi wa Aburahamu.

Uhoraho yarahezagiye cane databuja, aba umuntu akomeye cane. Yamuhaye imikuku y’intama n’impene, amasho y’inka, ubutunzi bw’ifeza n’inzahabu, abakozi b’abahungu n’abakobwa hamwe n’ingamiya n’indogoba.
Kandi Sara umugore wa databuja yamuvyariye umuhungu mu busaza bwiwe. Uwo muhungu ni we databuja yaraze ivyiwe vyose.
Databuja yarandahije avuga ati: ‘Ntuze uronderere umuhungu wanje umugore mu bakobwa b’Abanyakanani, abo mbayemwo.
Ariko uze ugende mu bo mu nzu ya data, mu bo mu bwoko bwanje, abe ari ho ukura umugore w’umwana wanje.’
Nanje mbwira databuja nti: ‘Nshobora kutaronka umukobwa ashaka gusubirana inyuma nanje.’

Aranyishura ati: ‘ Uhoraho namye numvira, azorungika umumarayika wiwe ajane nawe atume ugira umugisha mu rugendo rwawe, kugira ngo ushobore kuronkera umuhungu wanje umugore wo mu muryango wanje, wo mu nzu ya data.
Niwaja mu bo mu muryango wanje, iyi ndahiro nkurahije ntizogufata; naho bokwanka kuguha uwo mukobwa, iyi ndahiro nkurahije ntize igufate.’
Uno musi igihe nashika kw’iriba nasenze nti: ‘ Uhoraho , Mana ya databuja Aburahamu, ndakwinginze umpe kugira umugisha muri uru rugendo.
Raba mpagaze hambavu y’iri riba. Nihaza umukobwa kuvoma nkamubwira nti: “Ndakwinginze umpe amazi yo kunywa muri uwo mu bindi wawe,”
na we akambwira ati: “Ehe nunywe kandi nca mvomera n’ingamiya zawe na zo,” uwo aze abe ari we Uhoraho yatoranirije kuba umugore w’umuhungu wa databuja.’
Ntaraheza gusengera mu mutima wanje, nabonye Rebeka aseruka n’umubindi wiwe ku rutugu, aramanuka aja kw’iriba aravoma amazi. Maze ndamubwira nti: ‘Ndakwinginze umpe amazi yo kunywa.’
Yaciye anyarutsa kwururutsa umubindi wiwe wari ku rutugu, aravuga ati: ‘Ehe nunywe kandi nca mvomera n’ingamiya zawe na zo.’ Nuko ndanywa, hanyuma avomera n’ingamiya.
Maze ndamubaza nti: ‘Uri umukobwa wa nde?’ Na we arambwira ati: ‘Ndi umukobwa wa Betuweli, umuhungu Nahori yavyaranye na Milika.’ Nuko nca ndamwambika ihereni ku zuru n’ibikomo ku maboko,
maze nca ndapfukama mpimbaza Uhoraho , nshima Uhoraho Imana ya databuja Aburahamu kuko yandongoreye mu nzira nziza, ku mukobwa w’incuti yiwe kugira ngo abere umuhungu wa databuja umugore.
None, nimba mwiteguye kugirira ineza databuja no kumwereka ubwizigirwa, ndabasavye mumbwire, kandi nimba bitari uko na ho nyene mubimbwire, kugira ngo nje kuronderera ahandi.”
Nuko Labani na Betuweli baramwishura bati: “Ibi bintu vyavuye k’ Uhoraho , ni co gituma ata co dushobora kwongerako.
Rebeka ari hano, numujane abe umugore w’umuhungu wa shobuja, nk’uko Uhoraho yabivuze.”
Wa mukozi wa Aburahamu yumvise inyishu yabo, arapfukama ahimbaza Uhoraho .
Hanyuma asokorora ivyo gushaza vy’inzahabu n’ifeza hamwe n’impuzu abiha Rebeka. Yongera aha ingabire musazawe na nyina.
Hanyuma we na ba bagabo bagendana bararya bongera baranywa, maze barara aho. Bavyutse mu gitondo, aravuga ati: “Nimundeke nsubire kwa databuja.”
Musaza wa Rebeka na nyina wiwe baramwishura bati: “Turashaka ko Rebeka agumana natwe akanya, nk’imisi icumi, hanyuma azoheza agende.”
Ariko arababwira ati: “Ntimuntevye kuko Uhoraho yampaye kugira umugisha mu rugendo rwanje. Nimundekure ngende nsubire kwa databuja.”
Baravuga bati: “Hinge duhamagare Rebeka tumubaze ico yiyumvira.”
Nuko bahamagara Rebeka baramubaza bati: “Urashaka kujana n’uwu mugabo?” Arabishura ati: “Egome ndabishaka.”
Nuko basezera Rebeka n’incoreke yamureze babarungikana na wa mukozi wa Aburahamu n’abagendanye na we.
Bahezagira Rebeka bamubwira bati: “Mushiki wacu, uze urondoke uvyare ibihumbi n’ibihumbi; uruvyaro rwawe ruze rwigarurire ibisagara vy’abansi bawe.”
Nuko Rebeka n’incoreke ziwe burira kuri za ngamiya basubirana inyuma na wa mugabo. Uko ni ko wa mukozi wa Aburahamu yajanye Rebeka.
Ico gihe Isaka yari yamaze kuva i Beyeri-Lahayi-Royi aja kuba i Negebu, mu bumanuko bw’i Kanani.
Umugoroba umwe Isaka aja kugendagenda mu mirima. Yunamuye amaso, abona ingamiya ziza zitumbereye iyo ari.
Rebeka yunamutse akabona Isaka, aca arururuka ava ku ngamiya.
Abaza wa mukozi wa Aburahamu ati: “Uriya muntu agendagenda mu mirima ariko araza ngo duhure ni nde?” Aramwishura ati: “Ni databuja.” Nuko Rebeka afata igitambara aritwikira.
Wa mukozi abwira Isaka ivyo yakoze vyose.
Isaka ajana Rebeka mw’ihema. Iryo hema ryahora ari irya nyina Sara. Nuko amugira umugore wiwe kandi aramukunda cane. Uko ni ko Isaka yashoboye kwirurwa umubabaro yari yaratewe n’urupfu rwa nyina.
Hanyuma Aburahamu arongora uwundi mugore yitwa Ketura,
bavyarana Zimurani, Yokishani, Medani, Midiyani, Ishibaki na Shuwa.
Yokishani na we avyara Sheba na Dedani. Abakomotse kuri Dedani ni Abashuri, Abaletushi n’Abaleyuli.
Bene Midiyani ni Efa, Eferi, Hanoki, Abida na Eludaya. Urwo ni rwo ruvyaro Aburahamu yavyaranye na Ketura.
Nuko Aburahamu araga Isaka ivyo yari afise vyose.
Ariko imbere y’uko apfa, agabira abahungu yavyaye ku ncoreke ziwe, aca abarungika mu gihugu co mu buseruko kugira ngo abatandukanye na Isaka umuhungu wiwe.
Aburahamu yapfuye amaze imyaka ijana na mirongo indwi n’itanu.
Nuko aracikana, apfa yisaziye neza, ageze mu zabukuru; ahamvya ba sekuruza.
Abahungu biwe Isaka na Ishimayeli bamuhamba mw’isenga ry’i Makapela hafi y’i Mamure, mw’itongo rya Efuroni mwene Zohari Umuheti.
Iryo tongo Aburahamu yari yariguriye Abaheti. Aho ni ho Aburahamu yahambwe hamwe na Sara umugore wiwe.
Aburahamu amaze gupfa, Imana ihezagira Isaka umuhungu wiwe, kandi yaba hafi y’iriba rya Beyeri-Lahayi-Royi.
Uru ni rwo rukurikirane rw’abakomoka kuri Ishimayeli umuhungu Aburahamu yavyaye kuri Hagari, incoreke ya Sara y’Umunyegiputakazi.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abahungu ba Ishimayeli, nk’uko bakurikirana: imfura yiwe ni Nebayoti, hagakurikira Kedari, Adibeyeli, Mibusamu,
Mishima, Duma, Masa,
Hadadi, Tema, Yeturi, Nafishi na Kedema.
Aba ni bo bahungu icumi na babiri ba Ishimayeli. Umwe wese yabaye umukuru w’umuryango witirirwa izina ryiwe kandi aho babaye n’aho bacumbitse hitirirwa amazina yabo.
Ishimayeli yamaze imyaka ijana na mirongo itatu n’indwi, hanyuma aracikana ahamvya ba sekuruza.
Abakomotse kuri Ishimayeli babaye mu karere kava i Havila gushika i Shuri, mu buseruko bwa Egiputa utumbereye ahitwa Ashuri. Kandi babana nabi n’incuti zabo.
Uru ni rwo rukurikirane rw’abakomoka kuri Isaka, umuhungu wa Aburahamu. Aburahamu yavyaye Isaka.
Isaka amaze imyaka mirongo ine, arongora Rebeka, umukobwa wa Betuweli Umwaramu w’i Padani-Aramu, akaba na mushiki wa Labani Umwaramu.
Nuko Isaka asenga Uhoraho ku bw’umugore wiwe, kuko yari ingumba. Imana yishura isengesho rya Isaka, maze Rebeka asama inda y’amahasa.
Kubera ko abo bana baguma bagwanira mu nda yiwe, Rebeka aja kubaza Uhoraho ati: “Ni kuki ibi binshikiye?”
